title: AVP - Category
description:
At Pocket, we’ve experienced rapid growth in both revenue and scale over the past few years, further fueling our ambition. With a long-term vision, we are well-positioned and well-capitalized to drive sustained expansion.

We operate across diverse industries and geographies, tackling complex challenges that require leaders who can navigate ambiguity and drive impact. These roles demand the ability to solve novel, first-of-their-kind problems often without precedent. Thriving at Pocket requires a mix of high IQ and EQ, analytical rigor, and an entrepreneurial mindset.

We offer ambitious goals, complex problem-solving, and full ownership over execution. Prior experience solving similar problems isn’t required. What matters is adaptability, a willingness to learn and reinvent, and intellectual humility.

**You’ll be solving for one of these problem statements:**

* This role sits at the intersection of analytics, product, and growth; tackling first-time, complex challenges across diverse genres.
* Content Growth & Expansion: Improve CPI for new shows and scale high-performing content to reach new audience segments. Test, iterate, and scale both paid and organic channels to drive sustainable growth
* Revenue & Retention Optimization: Maximize monetization, improve retention metrics, and enhance user lifetime value
* AI-Driven Production & Scaling: Shift user acquisition testing from thumbnail optimization to AI-driven experiments and scale realistic AI-generated videos for content distribution
* Content Adaptation & Commissioning: Optimize content adaptation for broader appeal and identify high-potential growth shows across key categories
* Live-Action Production: Maintain and scale live-action content as a core part of our ongoing operations; leveraging A/B testing and advanced analytics to optimize content performance and acquisition strategies

**Here’s what we are looking for:**

* Astute problem-solving skills and the ability to break (seemingly) large problems into smaller, practical, solvable pieces with a data-driven approach to decision-making
* Someone who excels at developing and implementing a plan from concept to completion, generating measurable outcomes across retention, engagement, and monetization
* Track record of productive teamwork starts with “why” rather than “what,” enjoys getting hands dirty, and possesses a drive for continuous learning
* A deep understanding of user needs, preferably gained in consumer-first companies
* Comfort working with AI automation tools and exposure to LLM-based workflows to drive scalable growth initiatives
* Action bias: solves problems, executes, and iterates as needed

title: People Technology Delivery Lead
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**The Enterprise Technology Team**

The Enterprise Technology team builds and delivers the secure, scalable systems that power how our business runs. Our People Technology Team sits at the heart of this work, overseeing the full Hire-to-Retire technical ecosystem—including core applications like Workday, Greenhouse, and Cornerstone—and ensuring these platforms evolve alongside the company's growth. We partner closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Business Operations to bring data-driven, compliant, and innovative solutions to life.

**The Opportunity**

Reporting to the Director of People Technology, this role will serve as a Delivery Lead and Principal Product Analyst for Okta's People Technology portfolio, focused on the
**Growth & Talent**
pod. In this broad role, you will lead complex, multi-system initiatives spanning Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Performance, Learning, and Career Development. You will serve as the crucial conduit between Product Management, Recruiting/Talent Acquisition leadership, Talent Management, and People Operations, driving technical execution against a prioritized backlog to align with Okta's strategic workforce goals.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* **Strategic Leadership:**
  Technically scope and lead the delivery of multi-quarter, high-visibility, executive-sponsored projects across the Growth & Talent ecosystem (e.g., Greenhouse ATS integration & workflows, Cornerstone L&D platform optimization, and Workday Talent & Performance solutions).
* **Subject Matter Expertise:**
  Serve as the functional specialist and delivery lead for the Growth & Talent pod, specializing in talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, learning management, and career development technology integrations.
* **Core Systems Architecture & Integration:**
  Partner with enterprise architects and delivery engineers to drive seamless end-to-end integrations across
  **Greenhouse**
  (Applicant Tracking System),
  **Cornerstone**
  (Learning & Experience Platform), and
  **Workday**
  (Talent, Performance, Skills, and Core HCM).
* **Backlog & Execution Management:**
  Drive delivery against a prioritized backlog for aligned Talent Acquisition and Talent Management stakeholder groups, ensuring successful project execution from start to finish.
* **Agile & Scrum Execution:**
  Operate actively in a Scrum framework—breaking down complex epics and business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable technical tasks while participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
* **Process Innovation & AI Enablement:**
  Utilize functional and technical talent domain expertise to identify opportunities to optimize, automate, and innovate recruitment workflows, employee learning paths, and internal mobility through modern technology and AI capabilities.
* **Impediment Resolution:**
  Proactively identify and resolve project-level risks, cross-system integration blockers, and requirement trade-offs with Talent Acquisition and Talent Management stakeholders to ensure on-time delivery.
* **Mentorship & Influence:**
  Guide project teams through uncertainty, facilitate technical scoping workshops, and provide mentorship to junior analysts and developers.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:**
  Act as the primary conduit between Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and technical delivery teams, owning and writing detailed functional requirements, business process flows, data mappings, and use cases.

**What You'll Bring to the Role**

* **Experience:**
  10+ years of related experience in a professional People Technology / HRIS role with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6+ years with a Master’s degree.
* **Domain & System Expertise:**
  Deep functional and technical knowledge of core Growth & Talent platforms, specifically
  **Greenhouse**
  (ATS),
  **Cornerstone**
  (LMS/L&D), and
  **Workday Talent & Performance**
  (Succession, Performance Reviews, Goals, Feedback, Skills).
* **Delivery Leadership:**
  Proven track record as a Delivery Lead managing complex, multi-system HR technology initiatives, integrations, and feature rollouts.
* **Problem Solving & Systems Analysis:**
  Ability to handle complex issues spanning multiple applications, data structures, and HR processes, requiring analysis of diverse data factors.
* **Collaboration & Alignment:**
  Exceptional collaboration skills to build strong relationships with key stakeholders across Recruiting, HR Ops, and Talent Development, managing conflicting perspectives and reaching consensus.
* **Strategic Thinking:**
  Strategic mindset to anticipate future talent technology architecture needs, internal mobility initiatives, and proactive system optimizations.
* **Agile Leadership:**
  Strong leadership qualities to guide agile delivery pods, facilitate requirements workshops, and mentor team members.
* **Extra Credit:**
  Experience implementing AI/Automation use cases within HR tech (e.g., candidate matching, skill taxonomy mapping, automated learning pathways); relevant industry certifications (Workday Talent/Performance certifications, Agile/Scrum certification).

**The Okta Experience**

* Supporting Your Well-Being
* Driving Social Impact
* Developing Talent and Fostering Connection + Community

We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.
  
  
Okta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, or status as a protected veteran. title: Director, Technical Program Management
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
As a Technical Project Manager, you will serve as the strategic connective tissue between product strategy and cross-functional execution. This is a principal-level, hands-on leadership role. You are accountable for the delivery of the organization’s most complex, high-revenue initiatives - not for reporting on them - and you carry the dates yourself.
  
  
You will guide a team responsible for architecting the Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) framework and providing the operational infrastructure required to scale. You will be responsible for the integrity of the delivery process - managing the interdependencies between Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Commercial teams. You ensure that the company’s most significant investments are delivered with transparency, alignment, and high impact.
  
  
Greenfield initiatives are where this role earns its keep. New programs receive dedicated senior ownership rather than shared program management capacity borrowed across unrelated engineering projects. On these builds you set the plan, hold the commitments, remove blockers directly where you can, and escalate with a recommendation and a recovery path where you cannot.
  
  
Your success in this role will be measured by the increased velocity, predictability, and transparency of our most critical product investments.
  
  

* Significant increase in the percentage of top initiatives delivered on time and within scope.
* Reduction in the "administrative tax" on Product Managers, as measured by time reclaimed from manual reporting and tool maintenance.
* Improved internal satisfaction scores from Engineering, Data Science, and Commercial leaders regarding the clarity and reliability of the delivery pipeline.
* Greenfield initiatives hitting their committed launch dates, with this role personally accountable for those commitments.

Level, Location, and Scope
  
  

* Level. Principal-level. This is a senior individual leadership role, comparable in scope to an L7 Principal Technical Program Manager at a large technology company.
* Location. Bangalore-based, most of the engineering, product and data science team are also based in India.
* Dedication. Fully dedicated to Product Operations and the greenfield portfolio. This is not a shared resource split across multiple engineering projects.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Update and maintain a scalable Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) that bridges the gap between high-level roadmaps and delivery.
* Establish standardized stage-gates and "Definition of Ready/Done" criteria to ensure Engineering and Data Science receive high-quality, actionable requirements.
* Conduct quarterly audits of the delivery pipeline to identify friction points, automate manual handoffs, and reduce lead time without over-engineering the process.
* Own end-to-end delivery of the "Top 20" initiatives - those involving 3+ functional teams or multi-million revenue impact - from post-PRD alignment through launch. You hold the timeline and are answerable when it moves.
* Actively unblock the work. Identify and resolve cross-team resource conflicts and technical dependencies between Product, Tech, Data Science, and Operations, driving each issue to a decision rather than routing it onward.
* Stand up greenfield programs from zero: scope, sequencing, staffing needs, operating cadence, and launch criteria, with no existing process to inherit.
* Engage directly with Engineering and Data Science on architecture, data pipeline, and integration tradeoffs at enough depth to pressure-test estimates and challenge plans credibly.
* Escalate to executive leadership with a recommendation and a recovery plan attached, not a status color.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for high-value client steering committees and strategic data vendors (e.g., Netflix, Amazon) to ensure technical integrations stay on schedule.
* Design and own the executive dashboarding strategy, providing a "single source of truth" for product health (adoption, retention) and delivery health (predictability, throughput).
* Ensure Jira and Confluence are configured to provide clean, automated reporting, eliminating the need for Product Managers to manually aggregate status updates.
* Provide quarterly insights to the C-suite on execution trends, highlighting areas where resource reallocation may be necessary to meet Op Plan goals.
* Oversee the administration and configuration of Jira, Confluence, and associated add-ons to support a unified workflow across the department.
* Evaluate and implement emerging tools (AI-assisted productivity, roadmap visualization) that enhance the productivity of the Product and Tech teams.
* Maintain the centralized repository of best practices, templates, and guidelines that standardize how the organization builds and launches products.
* Lead quarterly training sessions to ensure new hires and existing team members are proficient in the PDLC and operational tools, ensuring a consistent culture of execution.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of experience in Product Operations, Technical Program Management, or Product Management, with at least 5 years operating at a principal or director level. For calibration: comparable in scope and seniority to an L7 Principal TPM at a company such as Amazon.
* Proven track record of managing "Top-Tier" strategic initiatives that require the synchronization of cross-functional areas (e.g., Engineering, Data Science, Operations, and Sales).
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing a Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) in a growth-stage or enterprise technology environment.
* Demonstrated ownership of greenfield, 0-to-1 programs where the plan, process, and cadence did not yet exist and had to be built.
* A track record of unblocking rather than tracking. Be ready to describe specific technical and organizational blockers you personally cleared, and launch dates you were held to.
* Technical fluency sufficient to hold a credible conversation with Engineering and Data Science leaders about architecture, data pipelines, and integration risk.
* Strong ability to translate raw delivery data into executive-level insights. Experience building automated dashboards that track both business health (KPIs) and delivery health (velocity, lead time).
* Exceptional ability to build consensus and maintain high-trust partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Customer Success and Commercial leadership.
* A passion for process as an enabler, not a hurdle. You should have a reputation for making the teams around you faster and more effective.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
* Professional certifications in Program Management (PMP, PgMP) are welcomed but secondary to proven real-world results.

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Lead AI Product Engineer
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
  
  
*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
The role
  
  
Cogentiq I2C is Fractal’s agentic AI Product for invoice-to-cash, covering Collections, Cash Application, Deductions, Invoice Management and Credit Risk. It runs on a Next.js front end, a FastAPI service layer, the Cogentiq agentic runtime, and a data tier on Azure Databricks with PostgreSQL.
  
  
You own the AI side: the agents, the models and everything that makes them accurate and dependable in front of a finance team. You design it, you lead the team that builds it, and you write code yourself.
  
  
What you will own
  
  

* Technical design of the AI side: agent decomposition, orchestration patterns, tool design, memory and context strategy.
* The agents across all five modules, from document extraction and matching through to the reasoning steps behind a recommendation.
* Accuracy and reliability. Evaluation sets, regression suites, and a defensible number for how well each agent performs before it ships.
* Guardrails and human oversight: confidence thresholds, escalation to a person, audit trails, and traceable reasoning for any decision touching cash.
* Predictive and machine learning models where they serve the product better than an agent does.
* Model strategy: choice of models, cost and latency per workflow, and the ability to switch providers without a rewrite.
* The interfaces between your side and the platform, agreed jointly with the engineering.

How you will work
  
  

* Lead the AI and agent engineering team. Set standards, coach engineers, and keep the team unblocked.
* Stay in the code. Take the hardest agents yourself and set the patterns others follow.
* Work as a pair with the Engineering Lead.
* Work with product management on what an agent can realistically be trusted to do, so external commitments are grounded.
* Be able to explain an agent’s behaviour to a finance stakeholder who will not accept "the model decided".

What you must have
  
  

* Ten to fourteen years in AI, machine learning or software, with at least three leading a team.
* Track record of owning technical design, not only implementing someone else’s design.
* Production experience with LLM and agentic systems: multi-step workflows, tool use, orchestration frameworks, and the failure modes that only appear at scale.
* Real evaluation discipline. Evidence that you have measured agent quality with something more rigorous than manual spot checks.
* Strong Python engineering. Your team ships production code, not notebooks.
* Document understanding and information extraction experience, ideally on messy real-world inputs such as emails, remittance advices and attachments.
* Classical machine learning depth alongside the generative work, and the judgement to know which problem needs which.
* Enough understanding of services, data and deployment to build agents that fit the platform and to hold your side of a design argument with the Engineering Lead.
* Product track record: AI built for many clients, not one-off delivery for a single engagement.

Good to have
  
  

* Order-to-cash or accounts receivable domain knowledge: collections, cash application, deductions, remittance handling.
* Experience with agent observability and tracing tooling.
* Experience getting AI through enterprise risk, compliance or model governance review.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
  
  
Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking
*Introduce Yourself*
in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

title: Product Manager — Travel & Hospitality Tech
description: PRODUCT MANAGER — HOTEL | FINKRAFT.AI Location: Bengaluru, HSR | Full-time | Level: L4 | Reports to: CPO / BU Head ABOUT FINKRAFT.AI Finkraft.ai is a B2B SaaS company that enables enterprises to maximise GST claims on travel and expense data. The platform automates invoice collection, validation, and reconciliation across airlines and hotels — helping finance teams at McKinsey, BCG, Capgemini, Abbott, and 1,250+ enterprises improve compliance, visibility, and cash recovery. We've recovered ₹300Cr+ in GST claims and are scaling from $1.5M to $10M ARR in 18 months. The Hotel vertical is our primary growth unlock for the next 18 months. This PM owns it. THE PROBLEM YOU ARE SOLVING A corporate employee books a hotel through a TMC or GDS. The booking passes through a PMS like Opera Cloud. The invoice is generated by the hotel, sometimes routed through a Concur integration or a bank lodge card program. By the time the finance team tries to claim GST on that invoice, the corporate GSTIN is missing, the folio is incomplete, the tax breakdown is wrong, or the invoice never arrived. title: Product Manager
description:
**Product Manager – Voice AI & LLM Chatbots**
Sense is hiring a Product Manager to own a major part of our Voice AI, LLM chatbot, and Agent Builder roadmap, from strategy and vendor decisions to delivery, quality, and customer outcomes.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will work on Sense's conversational AI products and set direction for your area with Product Leadership.
  
  

* Voice AI and AI Receptionist: outbound and inbound agents that screen candidates, collect data, answer questions, and hand off to recruiters.
* LLM chatbots: web and SMS agents built on the same platform.
* Agent Builder: a modular platform (Greeting, Data Collection, Screening, FAQ, Closing) with custom instructions, prompt architecture, ATS variables, testing tools, and publishing into Sense Workflows.
* Voice stack: telephony, speech-to-text, LLMs, and text-to-speech from multiple vendors, where latency, voice quality, and cost per call are product decisions.
* Integrations: ATS field mapping and note writeback, which decide whether a good conversation becomes a usable record.

The work is hard because outputs are non-deterministic, calls happen in real time, and staffing customers run high volumes under consent and compliance rules. You will work in the EPD (Engineering, Product, Design) triad with AI/ML, Customer Success, Implementation, and GTM teams.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Strategy**

* Own the roadmap and outcomes for one or more areas: voice agent quality and evals, Agent Builder platform capabilities, voice cost and architecture, or ATS and workflow integrations.
* Find where conversational AI can improve recruiter productivity, candidate experience, and outcomes such as screening completion and submission-to-placement conversion.
* Track advances in LLMs, speech models, and voice orchestration, and judge which are worth adopting.

**Execution**

* Turn ambiguous customer and business problems into PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that work for non-deterministic systems.
* Lead prioritization, sprint planning, and release coordination with Engineering, AI/ML, and Design.
* Work with QA on test coverage and run User Acceptance Testing before release.

**Platform and vendors**

* Define agent behaviors, modules, prompt architecture, and guardrails with AI/ML and Engineering.
* Make build-versus-buy and vendor decisions for speech, voice, and LLM components, with cost and quality trade-offs modeled.
* Improve unit economics, including prompt efficiency and cost per call.
* Define call outcomes and classifiers, such as consent revoked, human contact requested, and logical completion.
* Own ATS integration behavior, including field mapping and writeback.

**Quality, evals, and compliance**

* Build the approach to agent quality: call sampling, pre-release simulation, A/B testing, and voice-quality metrics.
* Improve observability so teams can see why a conversation went the way it did.
* Work with Legal and CS on consent, opt-out, and disclosure requirements.

**Customers and stakeholders**

* Run discovery sessions, demos, and roadmap conversations with customers, recruiters, and Implementation teams.
* Triage escalations, spot patterns across support tickets, and turn them into product fixes.
* Support pilots and account health reviews, and present to executives.

**Metrics you'll own**
**Area**
**Example metrics**
Conversation outcomes
  
  
Connect rate, call and chat completion rate, drop-off by module, human handoff rate
  
  
Business impact
  
  
Screening completion, submission-to-placement conversion, recruiter time saved
  
  
Quality
  
  
Evaluation scores, voice-quality measures, interruption and latency quality, issue volume by theme
  
  
Reliability
  
  
ATS writeback success rate, platform and vendor uptime, escalation volume
  
  
Economics
  
  
Cost per call, gross margin per bot, LLM and speech cost per conversation
  
  
Trust
  
  
Opt-out and complaint rates, compliance check pass rate
  
  
Adoption
  
  
Active bots and accounts, time to launch a new bot, customer satisfaction
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must have**

* BE/B.Tech or MBA, with 4–7 years of product management experience. Excellent academics.
* Shipped at least one LLM-powered, voice, or conversational product used by real customers.
* Practical understanding of prompt design, grounding, guardrails, and failure modes of LLM agents.
* Experience defining quality and evaluation approaches for AI or other non-deterministic systems.
* Hands-on experience working with LLM tools such as Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT, for example through a personal, academic, or work project using LLM APIs, prompts, chatbots, or voice agents.
* Strong analytical skills, including SQL and working with API and integration behavior.
* Good system design skills and knowledge of the software development life cycle.
* Excellent written and oral communication, including executive presentations.
* Ability to prioritize and balance multiple tasks, work well in a team, and apply feedback constructively.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with real-time voice systems such as telephony, speech-to-text, or text-to-speech.
* Experience with enterprise, multi-tenant configuration platforms.
* Exposure to HR tech, staffing, or high-volume candidate engagement.
* Familiarity with consent and compliance requirements for outbound calling and messaging.

**Why join**
You will work on products that talk to candidates at scale, with real customers and measurable outcomes. The team is small enough that you will influence architecture, vendor, and roadmap decisions early. Sense offers active mentorship, learning and development support, and a path to larger product leadership roles.

title: Senior Product Manager : F&E
description:
**About The Team**
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
  
  
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
  
  
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
  
  
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.
  
  
**What Will You Do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
* Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.

**What You Will Need**

* Overall experience of 7+ yrs with atleast 5+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

title: Senior Product Manager, Map Intelligence, Google Maps Platform
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 3 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 5 years of experience working cross-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders.
* 5 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
* 4 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to senior leadership.
* 3 years of experience in software development or engineering.
* 3 years of people management experience with direct reports, and in technical leadership.

**About The Job**
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
  
  
Geo Makers extends Geo’s mission by empowering millions of businesses and developers with real world platforms and solutions that help people explore, navigate and get things done in the real world. We do this by exposing various APIs collectively called Google Maps Platform (GMP). The customers use us in both Business-to-Consumer (B2C) (e.g. schedule a ride, locate a store or find your next vacation) and Business-to-Business (B2B) (manage a fleet of trucks, or assess insurance risk) contexts.
  
  
The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.
  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define the product goal, strategy and roadmap for the overall Map Intelligence Area, including our Maptrics platform, Insights Agents, and broader efforts supporting the emerging markets data needs.
* Provide leadership, mentorship, and cohesion across our site projects, including product efforts for India makers.
* Understand the needs of the broader Geo Makers team in order to identify and develop key insights tools and systems.
* Advocate awareness and use of Maptrics and insights both internally and externally in order to drive business success.

description:
**Our Mission:**
6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

At 6sense, our core predictive foundation provides the engine, but our specialized models provide the steering for specific business outcomes. We are looking for a
**Sr**
**Product Manager**
to own Specialized Modeling & Verticals—focusing on the intelligence that powers verticalized tasks and addresses specific B2B marketing needs.
  
  
You will work closely with the PM Lead to leverage foundational intelligence and build out specialized layers that solve the specialized enterprise revenue challenges.
  
  
**Why 6sense?**

* AI That Builds Pipe, Not Hype: Our Revenue AI™ identifies accounts ready to buy, crafts the right message, and qualifies meetings automatically. We don’t just surface data—we deliver intelligence and action.
* Crack the Dark Funnel™: Less than 3% of buyers engage early. We uncover hidden buying signals, decode the “breadcrumb trails,” and help revenue teams connect with buyers in ways they never could before.
* Orchestrate the Full Journey: From dynamic audience creation to multi-channel engagement, we empower marketers to reach the right accounts, at the right time, with the right message—across advertising, email, web, and sales.
* Arm Operations Teams: Integrate insights, centralize audience creation, and maximize impact by connecting 6sense with your tech stack. We’re the single canvas for your entire GTM strategy.

**Your Impact :**
As Sr Product Manager, Specialized Modeling & Verticals, you will:
  
  

* Drive Specialized Modeling Initiatives. Lead the roadmap for intelligence layers that address verticalized tasks and specific B2B marketing needs. You ensure that core signals are translated into high-value specialized business outcomes.
* Develop Specialized, Use-Case Specific Models. Partner with business stakeholders, customers, and data science teams to build specialized models fed by our core engines, ensuring our intelligence remains highly relevant and accurate across diverse business scenarios.
* Own the "Applied Intelligence" Roadmap. Work with the Predictive Lead to consume core engines and turn them into specialized features that solve complex, domain-specific challenges for the world's largest enterprises.
* Maximize Model Utility. Ensure that specialized models are built with a "leveraged" mindset—creating solutions that solve a broad class of problems rather than one-off custom requests.
* Define Domain-Specific Requirements. Act as the bridge between specialized business workflows (like Sales Ops or Demand Gen) and our data science teams, translating complex business problems into clean modeling requirements.
* Measure Impact in Context. Establish performance metrics that aren't just about model accuracy, but about how effectively these specialized signals drive real-world revenue outcomes.

**Strategic Themes You'll Drive :**

* Applied Precision. Ensure our core intelligence is accurately applied to the most complex and nuanced parts of the B2B data model.
* Use-Case Focused Intelligence. Ensure that intelligence models are optimized for specific B2B marketing scenarios and user requirements to maintain high relevance.
* The Last Mile of Prediction. Own the logic that turns a raw predictive score into a specific, high-confidence recommendation for a sales or marketing user.

**What You'll Bring :**

* Applied ML Expertise. You have experience managing ML products and are comfortable discussing model inputs, logic, and validation with data scientists.
* B2B Domain Knowledge. You understand the B2B revenue lifecycle—leads, accounts, opportunities, and the complex challenges that come with them.
* Strategic Partnering. A proven ability to work with other PMs. You know how to leverage foundational platforms to build specialized value.
* Execution Rigor. You excel at taking a high-level capability and turning it into a specific, shipped feature that solves a concrete user pain point.
* Experience. 4-6+ years in Product Management, with a focus on Data Products, AI/ML, or B2B SaaS applications.

**Why You’ll Love This Role :**

* Impact: You bring the power of 6sense Predictive Models to life for specific industries, turning generalized models into Applied Domain Expertise that solves unique revenue problems.
* Innovation: You will lead the effort to scale specialized intelligence across industries, identifying and productizing the niche signals that drive high-value outcomes for our most complex B2B customers.
* Growth: Join a rocket ship, learn every day, and accelerate your career in a collaborative, high-energy environment.
* Fun: We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. Expect GIFs, puns, and the occasional ABM meme.

**Our Benefits:**
Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.
  
  
We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.

We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com*

title: Sr Product Manager  - Media Measurements
description:
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Sr. Data Product Manager to own a portfolio of Target Media data products end-to-end — from business definitions and contracts through datasets, pipelines, quality, governance, and delivery.
  
  
This is a hands-on role that works closely with Data Engineering, Analytics and Media Partners. You will partner with DE day-to-day to build and evolve datasets and pipelines across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and contracts, and make sure the data products that result are trusted and well-governed. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes. You will sit at the intersection of Roundel product, Data Engineering, MediaOps, and the broader Media Data Consumers.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager — Measurement & Analytics to lead the strategy, development, and evolution of data products that enable marketing measurement and attribution across Target Media.
  
  
**Measurement – Must Have**
This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing Measurement, Analytics and Data Engineering. You will own products that help the organization understand the impact of marketing investments across channels, campaigns, audiences, and customer journeys.
  
  
The initial focus will be on Roundel and Target marketing spend, with the opportunity to expand measurement capabilities across loyalty, promotions, and other enterprise marketing investments.
  
  
A core responsibility will be building and scaling attribution and measurement capabilities that connect marketing exposure and spend to business outcomes, enabling stakeholders to understand what worked, why it worked, and where to invest next.
  
  
Analytics & Data Fluency — Must Have
  
  
Strong Working Knowledge Of Analytics And Data Concepts, With The Ability To Partner Effectively With Analytics Teams. You Should Be Comfortable With
  
  

* Customer-level and aggregated analytics
* Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
* Data pipelines and data transformations
* Data quality and reconciliation
* Metric definitions and semantic layers

Building data products with Data Engineering
  
  
You work hand-in-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs, prioritizing the backlog, and making trade-off calls with DE on design and sequencing.
  
  
Platform & ecosystem stewardship
  
  
Solid understand of Data Platform, cloud environment of GCP/BQ/PowerBI
  
  
Trust, governance & data quality — critical
  
  
Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. As operational systems and automated workflows act on Roundel data, the cost of a stale or wrong data product rises sharply.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years in product management, with meaningful time across Measurement, data products, data platforms, AdTech/MarTech, or retail media.
* Proven understanding Marketing Measurement concepts of Attribution, MTA, MMM, etc.
* Hands-on experience working closely with Data Engineering to build datasets and pipelines — writing specs, shaping schemas and contracts, and prioritizing a technical backlog.
* Solid understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and modern data platforms (Lakehouse, data mesh, or federated architectures), including lineage and cost.
* Strong grasp of data governance and data quality — certification, monitoring, access, and consent — treated as critical, not optional.
* Track record of translating technical capability into measurable business outcomes and influencing cross-functional partners without direct authority.
* Strong understand if PM Practices and working with Data Engineering, Analysts and Stakeholders.

title: Sr Product Manager
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
This job focuses to define and own the product strategy and roadmap for Payments and Payouts Platform including, card acquiring, bank payment processing, and payouts, balancing customer needs, business value, and technical dependencies. Gathering customer experience insights to inform product requirements and analyzing research, market data, and usability studies for data-driven decision-making. Own payment lifecycle requirements, including processing, settlement, reconciliation, payouts, and exception handling. Collaborate with business teams, engineering, architects, operations, risk, and compliance to build scalable capabilities and ensure launch readiness.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Uses data to build insights on product or platform requirements consistent with the shared vision for the product.
* Gathers insights from the customer experience and customer needs to input to product requirements
* Analyzes research, market analysis and usability studies, research and market analysis to support data-driven decision making
* Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
* Lead sprint planning, daily standups and retrospectives to drive execution. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
* Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers to identify new opportunities.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**
**Must-Have:**

* Must have atleast 3+years of relevant Product Management experience into Payments/Card Acquiring
* Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for Payments and Payouts Platform including, card acquiring, bank payment processing, and payouts, balancing customer needs, business value, and technical dependencies.
* Gather customer and stakeholder requirements and translate them into actionable product requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Lead end-to-end product development, from discovery and solution design through delivery, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with business teams, engineering, architects, operations, risk, and compliance to build scalable capabilities and ensure launch readiness.
* Own payment lifecycle requirements, including processing, settlement, reconciliation, payouts, and exception handling.
* Resolve customer issues, processing challenges, and delivery blockers through hands-on problem solving and root-cause analysis.
* Maintain stakeholder alignment, define success metrics, and remain accountable for product delivery and outcomes.

**Subsidiary:**
PayPal
  
  
**Travel Percent:**
0
  
  
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.
  
  
For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.
  
  
**Who We Are:**
Click Here to learn more about our culture and community.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.
  
  
**Belonging at PayPal:**
Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.
  
  
Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.
  
  
We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

title: Justdial - Product Manager - Smart Assist
description:
**Job Description**
Build the AI that runs a business's front desk | PM - Smart Assist, JustDial
  
  
Every day, lakhs of Indian businesses miss calls, lose customers and leave money on the table. We're building Smart Assist: an AI receptionist that doesn't just pick up the phone, it runs the conversation.
  
  
It answers every call, understands what the customer wants, handles objections, negotiates and closes. Next, it picks up the phone itself, making outbound calls to follow up, re-engage and sell on the vendor's behalf.
  
  
We want a PM to take this from a smart bot to a bot that grows businesses.
  
  
**What You'll Build**

* The brain of the bot: how it handles calls, reads intent and responds the way a great receptionist would
* Outbound calling: follow-ups, reminders, re-engagement and selling
* Intelligence on top: call insights, lead quality and smart next actions for the vendor
* Advanced features that make vendors say "I can't run my business without this"
* GTM: taking what you build to market and making it land

Along the way you'll talk to vendors and users constantly, own the roadmap, keep a sharp eye on competitors, and rally tech, design, sales and leadership around your plan.
  
  
**You're Our Person If You**

* Are from IIT / IIM / FMS / IIFT or an equivalent tier-1 institute
* Have 2 - 3 years of experience owning a product, not just shipping tickets
* Are self-driven: you spot the problem, own it and push it through without waiting to be told
* Get energy from talking to users and turning messy feedback into sharp product
* Can manage stakeholders and drive a launch end to end
* Bonus: You've built or worked closely on voice bots or conversational AI

This is not a maintain-the-roadmap role. It's a take-it-to-the-next-level role.
  
  
(ref:hirist.tech)

description:

Years

SaaS / AI Platforms / Data Products / B2B Software

* 4+ years of hands-on Product Management experience in B2B SaaS, AI Platforms, Data Platforms, API Products, Developer Tools, or Product-based companies.

* Experience defining pricing, packaging, subscription, usage-based, or API monetization models for B2B SaaS products.

* Experience collaborating with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Growth, Partnerships, and Leadership teams to build and launch scalable products.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong written communication skills with experience writing Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Release Notes, and Product Documentation.
* Experience working with global teams across India, the US, LATAM, and Europe.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership, commercial thinking, and data-driven decision-making.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for AIMLEAP's Pricing Intelligence Platform and Data API Platform.
* Support the roadmap and product evolution of Risk Monitoring, Data Extraction, and AI Development products.
* Define product goals, North Star Metrics, KPIs, and success metrics aligned with business objectives.
* Conduct continuous customer discovery through interviews, customer feedback, product analytics, support tickets, and market research.
* Convert customer insights into prioritized product roadmaps and outcome-driven backlogs.
* Identify opportunities to transform AIMLEAP's service offerings into scalable SaaS products.
* Define pricing strategies, product packaging, commercial models, and go-to-market recommendations.
* Prepare detailed PRDs, User Stories, Functional Specifications, Acceptance Criteria, Wireframes, and Product Documentation.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering teams during sprint planning, backlog grooming, product development, testing, and releases.
* Monitor product KPIs including Product Adoption, Activation, Retention, API Usage, API Latency, Data Freshness, Scraping Success Rate, Customer Satisfaction (NPS), and Feature Adoption.
* Build dashboards and reports using Product Analytics and BI tools to measure product performance.
* Partner with Engineering teams to evaluate technical feasibility, APIs, scalability, architecture, and implementation trade-offs.
* Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Growth, and Partnerships teams to define ICPs, positioning, messaging, pricing tiers, and product launches.
* Collaborate with Security and Compliance teams to ensure products comply with GDPR, Ethical Data Practices, ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and CMMI Level 3 standards.
* Establish Product Management best practices including product discovery frameworks, roadmap reviews, governance processes, customer feedback loops, and documentation standards.
* Stay updated with emerging SaaS, AI, Data Platform, API, and Product Management trends to continuously improve AIMLEAP's product portfolio.
* Mentor cross-functional teams by promoting customer-centric thinking, product excellence, and data-driven decision-making.

**Qualifications**

* MBA from a Tier-1 or Tier-2 Institute (Mandatory).
* 3-6 years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS, AI Platforms, API Products, Data Platforms, or Developer Tools.
* Proven experience building and launching products from concept to commercialization.
* Strong understanding of Product Strategy, Product Lifecycle, Agile Delivery, Product Analytics, and Customer Discovery.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, Product Analytics platforms, REST APIs, and SaaS product architecture.
* Experience working closely with Engineering teams on product development, feature releases, and platform enhancements.
* Strong understanding of subscription-based, usage-based, or API-based pricing models.
* Excellent communication, leadership, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
* Prior experience in Web Scraping, Data Extraction, Alternative Data, Pricing Intelligence, Competitive Intelligence, Product-Led Growth (PLG), or Services-to-Product transformation will be an added advantage.
* Experience working in a Startup, Small, or Mid-sized organization with a fast-paced, high-ownership culture will be highly preferred.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About Aerchain (Why Us?)
 



  





 We’re rewriting the rules of procurement with an AI\-first platform that powers $20B\+ in enterprise spend.
 



  





 From $4M ARR today to $25M ARR and beyond, our mission is to build enterprise\-grade, AI\-first procurement software for global enterprises across manufacturing, FMCG, and services.
 



  





 Role Snapshot
 



  





 You’ll own one or more high\-complexity modules and be accountable for the outcomes they drive across customers. You’ll work with enterprise clients to ensure they realise value from the product, lead solutioning for complex accounts, define what your modules build and why, and ensure they deliver measurable customer value. You’ll work across business, engineering, and leadership, and mentor PMs / Builders. You build the solution yourself, prototyped in AI, and engineering builds forward from what you’ve made rather than from a blank page.
 



  





 What You’ll Drive
 



  





 Problem Discovery \& Research
 



  




* Drive discovery for your modules: understand customer problems, workflows, and success criteria at the deepest level.
* Diagnose and size problems to a standard others can follow. Pressure\-test recommendations, including your own.
* Zero escalations without a fully formed recommendation and reasoning.



  





 Customer Ownership
 



  




* Own Tier A or Tier B customer engagements end\-to\-end, from understanding their problems to ensuring they realise value from the product.
* Solution enterprise clients independently, coordinating with PMs / Builders where modules overlap.
* Be the single point of contact for Tier A or Tier B customers through delivery, adoption, and outcome validation.



  





 Solutioning \& Prototyping
 



  




* Own the roadmap for your modules: what gets built, deferred, and killed, with reasoning tied to customer outcomes.
* Write the PRDs and build the prototypes for your modules: scenarios, edge cases, and acceptance criteria all present before grooming. Review PM / Builder work and find what’s missing.
* Build your prototypes in AI and hand them to engineering as the foundation they build forward from.
* Backend, hardening, and refinement of functionality all start from your prototype, not a blank page.
* Use AI across every step: research, problem framing, drafting, prototyping, validation. Set the standard for your modules.



  





 Execution \& Delivery
 


* Own delivery for your modules. Coordinate across engineering and business teams and unblock issues before they become delays.
* Own the quality bar for your modules. A delivery failure in your modules is your failure.



  





 Release \& Adoption
 



  




* Define and track the customer\-value metrics for your modules, metrics that answer: is this module making procurement measurably better?
* Own post\-release outcomes for Tier A or Tier B customers. Stay in the loop until value is confirmed.
* Mentor PMs / Builders: show them what good looks like.



  





 You’ll thrive here if
 



  




* 6–9 years in product roles with clear progression from feature ownership to module ownership.
* You diagnose complex, ambiguous problems and make high\-stakes calls with confidence.
* You use AI as a core part of how you work and raise the bar for those around you, and you build with it, prototyping solutions engineering carries forward.
* You develop people by doing: you show PMs / Builders what good looks like, not just tell them.
* You own outcomes, not activities. You stay in the loop until value is confirmed, not until the feature ships.
* Bonus: exposure to enterprise SaaS, complex B2B environments, or procurement tech.



  





 What’s In It For You
 



  




* Module\-level ownership with full authority over what gets built and why.
* Work with enterprise clients on problems that matter, and stay accountable until value is confirmed.
* A direct line to a Principal PM / Lead Builder, with no bureaucracy between your judgment and the decisions that matter.
* A culture where problem solving, ownership, and action are rewarded, and the opposite is called out.



  





 Ready to build Aerchain’s future?
 



  





 If reimagining business engines with AI and solving problems at scale excites you, let’s talk.
 



  





 Apply now and help us build the most agile enterprise SaaS story in the world.

title: Principal Product Manager - AI
description:
**Why this role exists** 




  





 Most AI product teams are busy shipping features. We're building JustCall's AI organization to ship outcomes \- creating AI experiences customers trust, adopt, and rely on every day.
 



  





 We are hiring a Principal Product Manager, AI to own the product strategy and execution behind JustCall's AI native communication platform \- anchored on our AI Voice Agent (AIVA), AI Conversation Intelligence and the next products we ship on the path to an intelligent, omnichannel communication OS.
 



  





 This is a senior, deeply hands\-on product leadership role. You'll define the product vision, shape the roadmap and partner closely with Engineering, Design, and AI leadership to ship AI experiences that customers actually trust. You'll obsess over user problems, AI quality and the unit economics of voice. You'll be in the prompts, the evals and customer calls as much as you are in the strategy decks.
 



  





**What you'll actually do** 




  




* Own product strategy and roadmap for JustCall's AI portfolio \- AI Voice Agent (AIVA), AI Conversation Intelligence and the next AI native products we ship.
* Translate customer problems into sharp product bets. Stay close to customers \- listen to real calls, sit in on rollouts, run discovery sessions and turn what you hear into product decisions.
* Partner deeply with Engineering and AI leadership on architecture tradeoffs, model selection, eval frameworks and the build\-vs\-buy\-vs\-partner calls that shape the AI stack.
* Define and own the quality bar for AI experiences \- what "good" looks like for accuracy, latency, hallucination and customer trust
* Drive go\-to\-market alongside Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success \- pricing, packaging, positioning and enablement for AI products.



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* 7\+ years of product management experience in SaaS, AI/ML, or platform products \- with a track record of owning complex, customer\-facing products end to end.
* Proven experience shipping AI\-powered products at scale \- agentic systems, LLM applications, etc.
* Strong awareness of the AI ecosystem, including emerging models, platforms, startups and product launches. Stays current on industry developments and can translate advances in AI into meaningful product opportunities and competitive advantage.
* Strong technical fluency \- you can hold your own with engineers on model selection, RAG architectures, eval frameworks, prompting strategies, latency tradeoffs, etc.
* A bias toward being in the product \- you read traces, write prompts, test agent flows, and demo the work yourself.
* Deep customer empathy \- you have sat with users, listened to real calls, and translated messy signals into sharp product decisions.
* Operational rigor \- you ship measurable improvements in quality, adoption, and retention. Excellent judgment on when to go deep, when to delegate, and when to push back.
* Comfortable in fast\-moving environments where the AI capabilities shift monthly and ambiguity is the default.

**Position Summary**
 The Commodity Life Cycle Manager (CLCM) is responsible for the end\-to\-end health, sustainability, and lifecycle management of assigned commodity portfolios across the product lifecycle. The CLCM serves as the single point of accountability for proactive component risk management, supplier lifecycle alignment, obsolescence forecasting, qualification strategies, and change execution to ensure supply continuity, product reliability, cost optimization, and long\-term platform sustainability.
   

  

 The role partners closely with Product Line Managers (PLMs), Design Engineering, Supply Chain, Commodity Business Management (CBM), Supplier Quality, Manufacturing, Service, and Obsolescence Engineering teams to drive planned lifecycle management rather than reactive end\-of\-life response.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Commodity Portfolio Ownership**
 Own the lifecycle strategy for assigned commodities, part families, and technologies.
   

  

 Maintain commodity roadmaps aligned to product roadmaps and supplier technology transitions.
   

  

 Monitor portfolio health, proliferation, standardisation opportunities, and preferred part adoption.
   

  

 Drive commodity sustainability and long\-term availability strategies
   

  

**Lifecycle Risk Management**
 Identify and assess lifecycle risks including:
   

  

 OEM End\-of\-Life (EOL)
   

  

 Supplier discontinuances
   

  

 Single\-source exposure
   

  

 Geopolitical and supply\-chain risks
   

  

 NRND (Not Recommended for New Design) components
   

  

 Develop mitigation plans and prioritise actions based on business impact.
   

  

 Establish leading indicators and lifecycle risk dashboards
   

  

**Obsolescence Prevention \& Forecasting**
 Drive proactive obsolescence management across product portfolios.
   

  

 Forecast future lifecycle events and component constraints.
   

  

 Build replacement strategies well before supplier notifications.
   

  

 Reduce reactive engineering activity through planned lifecycle interventions
   

  

**Solution Development \& Change Execution**
 Lead selection and qualification of alternate parts.
   

  

 Coordinate engineering validation and change implementation.
   

  

 Drive ECR/ECO and product change activities related to lifecycle events.
   

  

 Ensure changes meet cost, reliability, quality, and supply continuity objectives
   

  

**Supplier Lifecycle Engagement**
 Establish strategic relationships with key suppliers.
   

  

 Review supplier technology roadmaps and lifecycle notifications.
   

  

 Influence supplier plans to minimise business disruption.
   

  

 Align sourcing strategies with long\-term product requirements
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Governance**
 Partner with:
   

  

 Product Line Managers
   

  

 Design Engineering
   

  

 Commodity Business Managers
   

  

 Supplier Quality
   

  

 Manufacturing Engineering
   

  

 Service \& Spares teams
   

  

 Lead lifecycle review forums and risk governance processes.
   

  

 Communicate lifecycle status and mitigation plans to leadership.
   

  

**Analytics \& Digital Transformation**
 Maintain lifecycle intelligence tools and dashboards.
   

  

 Analyze portfolio health metrics, risk trends, and backlog performance.
   

  

 Drive data\-driven decision making for lifecycle investments.
   

  

 Support digital transformation initiatives related to component lifecycle management.

 Full time

title: Delivery Manager
description:
At PwC, our people in software and product innovation focus on developing cutting\-edge software solutions and driving product innovation to meet the evolving needs of clients. These individuals combine technical experience with creative thinking to deliver innovative software products and solutions.
   

  

 Those in software engineering at PwC will focus on developing innovative software solutions to drive digital transformation and enhance business performance. In this field, you will use your knowledge to design, code, and test cutting\-edge applications that revolutionise industries and deliver exceptional user experiences.
   

  

 Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team member’s unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
   

  

**Skills**

* Analyse and identify the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system.
* Take ownership of projects, ensuring their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
* Partner with team leadership to ensure collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables.
* Develop skills outside your comfort zone, and encourage others to do the same.
* Effectively mentor others.
* Use the review of work as an opportunity to deepen the expertise of team members.
* Address conflicts or issues, engaging in difficult conversations with clients, team members and other stakeholders, escalating where appropriate.


 Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
* Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
* As a Scaled Engineering Services
* Application Development and Operations Manager, you will lead the charge in driving innovation within our Advisory practice. You will be at the forefront of software and product innovation, overseeing the development and operations of cutting\-edge applications. As a Manager, you will guide and mentor teams, leveraging your strategic planning skills and business acumen to deliver exceptional client support. You will play a pivotal role in managing client service accounts, developing high\-quality deliverables, and fostering meaningful client relationships.
* In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for leading teams and managing client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. Your leadership will inspire others to deliver quality, while you embrace technology and innovation to enhance delivery. You will also be expected to uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. This is an opportunity to develop your leadership style and contribute to the success of our firm.


**Responsibilities**
* Leading the development and operations of scalable software applications within a managed services environment
* Overseeing the implementation of application development methodologies, including Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD) and Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)
* Managing client relationships and expectations to deliver exceptional service and support
* Guiding teams in the use of programming languages such as Java, Python, and C\#.NET for software engineering projects
* Lead development and support engagements, accelerating practical AI adoption across software engineering workflows.
* Coordinating the integration of enterprise applications and microservices to enhance system functionality
* Conducting code reviews and enforcing coding standards to maintain quality software development practices
* Facilitating business process improvement initiatives through strategic questioning and analytical thinking
* Promoting the adoption of innovative technologies and software development methodologies across teams
* Confirming the integrity and security of software applications through rigorous testing and troubleshooting


**What You Must Have**
* At least 12 years of experience
* Bachelor's Degree
* In lieu of a degree, individuals may be considered if they have demonstrated three years of specialized training and/or progressively responsible work experience for each missing year of college in addition to the 12 years of experience required.
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


**What Sets You Apart**
* Demonstrating proficiency in Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD)
* Utilizing advanced skills in API Management and Application Development
* Excelling in Business Process Management and Improvement
* Leading teams in Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices
* Managing complex Software Engineering projects with strategic planning
* Hands on experience developing AI agents and institutionalizing AI adoption in day\-to\-day tasks
* Mentoring junior staff in Software Development Methodologies and Practices
