title: Implementation Lead
description:
About Aerchain (Why Us?)
 



  





 We’re rewriting the rules of procurement with an AI\-first platform that powers $20B\+ in enterprise spend.
 



  





 From $4M ARR today to $25M ARR and beyond, our mission is to build enterprise\-grade, AI\-first procurement software for global enterprises across manufacturing, FMCG, and services.
 



  





 Role Snapshot
 



  





 You’ll own a portfolio of enterprise accounts and the value they realise — leading a team of Engagement Managers and holding the outcome, not just the delivery. You’re the senior Aerchain owner for your portfolio: accountable for adoption, value realisation, retention and growth, the executive relationship, and the commercial health of every account. You set the delivery and governance standard your Engagement Managers run to, step in on the hardest escalations, and develop the team. You report to the Business Head.
 



  





 What You’ll Drive
 



  





 Portfolio \& Value Ownership
 



  




* Own the outcomes across your portfolio — accountable for value realised, not just features shipped or projects closed.
* Hold the customer\-value metrics standard across all accounts; ensure every account can point to measurable value.
* Own the executive relationship with your portfolio’s most senior stakeholders.



  





 Team Leadership — Engagement Managers
 



  




* Lead and develop a team of Engagement Managers — build their judgment, and shape their output.
* Set the delivery, governance, and quality standard your Engagement Managers run to;
* review account health and keep them unblocked.
* Own allocation and coverage across the portfolio; step in personally on the hardest accounts and escalations.



  





 Customer Success
 



  




* Own retention, renewals, and expansion across the portfolio — protect and grow account value.
* Run executive business reviews; translate product value into customer outcomes and references.
* Own account health — renewal risk, expansion pipeline, and margin — partnering with Sales.



  





 Delivery Governance \& Escalation
 



  




* Set portfolio\-level governance, cadence, and predictability standards; oversee delivery health across all accounts.
* Be the final escalation point for your portfolio — internal and customer — resolving what Engagement Managers can’t.
* Confirm readiness and own go/no\-go at the portfolio level for major go\-lives.



  





 Adoption \& Product Feedback
 



  




* Drive adoption across accounts — ensure users reach value and stay to value, not just go\-



 live.
 



 Feed structured, prioritised customer insight back into product to shape the roadmap.
 



  





 You’ll thrive here if
 



  




* 12–16 years in enterprise SaaS delivery, customer success, engagement / account management, or product / solution consulting — with real portfolio and people\-leadership experience.
* You’ve owned delivery, outcomes and retention / expansion for enterprise accounts.
* You develop people by doing — you show Engagement Managers what good looks like.
* You operate at executive level — calm, structured communication and confident escalation ownership.
* You’re pragmatic under pressure, with a critical\-path focus.
* Procurement / supply chain / spend\-management domain exposure and strong B2B SaaS understanding.
* You’re comfortable holding both delivery and commercial accountability across an enterprise portfolio.
* Bonus: experience with Indian \& US enterprise customers; MBA preferred.



  





 What’s In It For You
 



  




* Own a portfolio and its value end\-to\-end, with a team of Engagement Managers.
* A senior mandate to shape how enterprise value is delivered — with authority and ownership.
* A direct line to leadership, with no bureaucracy between your judgment and the decisions.
* Influence product direction through structured portfolio insight.
* A high\-growth environment scaling from $4M → $25M ARR and beyond.
* A culture where problem solving, ownership, and action are rewarded.



  





 Ready to build Aerchain’s future?
 



  





 If owning enterprise value at portfolio scale — and leading the people who deliver it — excites
 



 you, let’s talk. Apply now and help us build the most agile enterprise SaaS story in the world.

**Qualifications**

title: Product Owner II
description:
**Company Introduction**
 Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting\-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.
   

  

 Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**About Availity**
 Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real\-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.
   

  

**About Availity India**
 Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India teams' partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.
   

  

 Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a
 **Product Owner II** 
 for the
 **Clearinghouse \& Gateway Platform team (India)** 
 to act as the critical bridge between Product Management and Engineering. This role is responsible for translating strategic product vision into high\-quality execution across complex, high\-volume healthcare transaction platforms.
   

  

 Reporting to the Manager of Product, you will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, and cross\-functional teams to ensure the delivery of scalable, data\-driven, and customer\-centric capabilities across Availity’s Clearinghouse and Intelligent Gateway ecosystem.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead product and feature strategy from concept through launch and ongoing optimization by identifying market opportunities, defining product vision, and ensuring revenue and profitability objectives are achieved.
* Partner closely with design, engineering, and cross\-functional stakeholders to drive product design, prioritization, roadmap development, and execution while owning overall product success.
* Leverage data, analytics, and customer insights to inform decision\-making, prioritize initiatives, and continuously improve product outcomes.
* Ensure release readiness by validating features, supporting go\-to\-market planning, and removing delivery roadblocks.
* Continuously identify opportunities to enhance the platform through automation, AI\-driven capabilities, and innovation while collaborating with product leadership to assess market viability, articulate ROI, and champion the product internally and externally.


**Required Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of Product Management / Product Owner experience, with strong ownership of product execution.
* Mandatory experience in U.S. Healthcare RCM, Clearinghouse, or Revenue Cycle platforms.
* Deep understanding of:
* Claims lifecycle, eligibility, ERA, prior auth, and payer\-provider workflows
* Clearinghouse operations (validation, routing, transaction processing)
* Strong experience with EDI transactions (X12\), APIs, and healthcare data exchange ecosystems.
* Experience building or working with:
* Dashboards, reporting, and analytics solutions
* Data\-driven product features and insights
* Strong proficiency in:
* Writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements
* Backlog prioritization and Agile product delivery
* Experience with Agile/Scrum tools (Jira, Confluence) and working within SAFe or similar frameworks.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to connect business workflows to technical solutions.
* Awareness of emerging AI capabilities and trends and their application in product development.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* B.Tech (Engineering degree) is required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience building or contributing to AI\-native or AI\-driven products.
* Hands\-on technical understanding:
* Exposure to REST APIs, microservices, and cloud architecture
* Ability to query databases (SQL) for analysis and validation
* Exposure to:
* Cloud platforms (Azure / AWS)
* API platforms or developer ecosystems
* Healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7\)
* Experience working on high\-scale transaction platforms (millions/billions of transactions).
* Familiarity with:
* Data pipelines, workflow orchestration, or billing systems
* Product analytics tools (Power BI, Pendo, etc.)
* Experience in a healthcare technology or platform\-driven organization.


**Why Join Availity India?**
* Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
* Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
* Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
* Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office\-based models.
* Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.
* Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.
* Office experience: For office\-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night\-shift transportation support.


**What To Expect From The Hiring Process**
 Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offer discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
 Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.
   

  

**Eligibility**
**Video Camera Usage**
*Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera\-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.*
*Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non\-participants.*

title: Sr. Mgr/Director of Product Management
description:
At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.
   

  

 For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off\-the\-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.
   

  

 Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.
   

  

**Title** 
 : Sr Manager / Director, Product Management
   

  

**Location** 
 : Bangalore
   

  

**Reporting to** 
 : VP, Product Management
   

  

**Department** 
 : Product Management
   

  

**The role (why we are hiring)**
 We are standing up a new product team in India to own the administration experience end to end: governance, platform administration, data synchronization, application lifecycle management, and the knowledge layer that makes the platform trustworthy at scale. This is one of the most important parts of our product and the part that large customers depend on most.
   

  

 We are hiring a player\-coach to own this domain and build the team. You will directly manage two senior product managers, set the strategy for the administration persona, and personally own the knowledge layer. You will report to the VP of Product and be the anchor for this new team.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own the strategy and roadmap for administration: governance, admin, sync and integration reliability, application lifecycle management, and the knowledge layer.
* Lead as a player\-coach. Manage and grow two senior PMs while personally owning the knowledge layer and shaping the highest\-leverage bets yourself.
* Make the platform trustworthy at scale. Reduce the friction admins face today, from first setup to ongoing management, so customers can adopt broadly and safely.
* Partner with Engineering, Design, Security, and Support to deliver measurable improvements in governance adoption and admin satisfaction.
* Build the operating rhythm of a new team: discovery, prioritization, delivery, and a strong connection to customers and the field despite the distance.
* Represent the administration persona with customers, Sales, and Customer Success, and turn what you learn into a clear point of view.


**What Success Looks Like**
* A credible, well\-run administration product team in India with clear ownership and momentum.
* Governance and admin experiences that are materially easier to adopt and manage, reflected in retention and expansion.
* A knowledge layer that raises the quality of everything built on the platform, including AI.


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* 8\+ years in product management, including experience leading or mentoring other product managers.
* Deep SaaS product experience, ideally with a PaaS or platform product.
* Highly technical. You understand APIs, data models, and how systems integrate, and can go deep with engineering, without being a developer yourself.
* Depth in platform, governance, administration, security, or data domains.
* A track record of owning complex, technical product areas and delivering measurable outcomes.
* You work fluently with leading AI tools and use them daily in your product work.
* Strong people leadership. You can hire, coach, and hold a high bar.
* Excellent communication across time zones and with executive stakeholders.


**Preferred**
* Low\-code or no\-code platform experience is a bonus.
* Some design ability, and comfort prototyping your own ideas with tools like Figma, Figma Make, or Claude Design.
* Experience standing up or scaling a new team.
* Familiarity with governance, compliance, or IT administration for enterprise software.
* Experience with audits and attestations like SOC2, ISO, and other frameworks.


**How You Work**
* Player\-coach, comfortable leading a team and owning a surface yourself.
* Systems thinker, energized by the unglamorous work that earns customer trust.
* Strong operator who builds rhythm and clarity for a new team.
* Low\-ego, high\-ownership, and effective across distance.


**Why Quickbase**
 You will build a new team from the ground up and own the domain that large customers rely on to trust and scale Quickbase. It is high\-ownership, high\-impact work with a direct line to product leadership.

title: Director of Product
description:
**About Aurigo** 




 Aurigo is an AI\-native capital program management platform trusted by over 300 customers managing more than $450 billion in capital programs across North America. With over 40,000 projects delivered, Aurigo helps organisations in transportation, water and utilities, healthcare, higher education, and government plan, build, and manage infrastructure with confidence. Recognised as one of the Top 25 AI Companies of 2024 and a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, we leverage artificial intelligence to create smarter, more connected outcomes. At Aurigo, we don't just build software — we help shape the future of infrastructure.
 



  





**Director of Product Management** 




**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India
 



**Department:** 
 Product Management
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Director of Product Management to lead one of Aurigo's core product areas. You will own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery outcomes for your area, working across engineering, design, and go\-to\-market teams to ship products that capital owners trust with billion\-dollar programs. This is a high\-ownership leadership role for a product director who can think strategically, engage credibly with enterprise customers, and build a team that executes at the pace the business requires.
 



  





**Roles and Responsibilities** 



* Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for your assigned product area, aligning with company goals and market priorities.
* Lead and develop a team of Senior Product Managers, creating clarity on priorities, developing their skills, and holding the quality bar.
* Work closely with engineering and design leadership to ensure product requirements are clear, delivery is predictable, and quality meets the standard that enterprise capital owners expect.
* Engage directly with enterprise customers including government agencies and commercial capital owners to deeply understand their workflows, pain points, and decision\-making processes.
* Collaborate with product marketing to develop positioning, value propositions, and go\-to\-market content for your product area.
* Support pre\-sales and sales cycles including demos, RFP responses, and technical discovery calls in partnership with the sales team.
* Define success metrics for your product area and use them to guide prioritisation and investment decisions.
* Work cross\-functionally with other product Directors to ensure coherence across the Aurigo platform, as no product area operates in isolation.
* Represent your product area in leadership reviews, investor discussions, and customer advisory conversations.



  





**Soft Skills** 



* Strong executive presence. Can present product strategy and roadmap to C\-suite buyers, agency directors, and investors with equal credibility.
* Clear and direct communicator. Produces crisp written and verbal communication for engineers, customers, and executives.
* Ability to develop senior product managers and build a high\-performing team.
* Strategic thinker who stays accountable for delivery and is comfortable moving between long\-term planning and sprint\-level decisions.
* Collaborative across functions and works well with engineering, sales, marketing, and customer success without creating friction.



  





**Hard Skills** 



* Proven experience leading product teams and delivering complex B2B SaaS products end to end.
* Strong product strategy and roadmap management skills. Can build a compelling multi\-year roadmap and defend the prioritisation decisions within it.
* Experience engaging directly with enterprise customers as a product leader.
* Track record of working effectively with engineering and design to ship high\-quality products on schedule.
* Data\-driven approach to product decisions. Defines metrics, measures outcomes, and uses data to course\-correct.



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Proficiency with product management tools such as Aha, Jira, Confluence, and Figma.
* Understanding of enterprise SaaS architecture, API\-based integrations, and platform design principles.
* Familiarity with AI product development including agent frameworks, large language model orchestration, and responsible AI practices.
* Ability to engage credibly in architecture discussions with engineering leadership.



  





**Educational Qualifications** 




 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA from a premium institution preferred.
 



  





**Prior Experience** 



* 14 or more years of experience in product management, with at least 3 to 4 years in a Director or equivalent senior leadership role.
* Proven track record managing B2B SaaS products for enterprise or government markets.
* Experience leading Senior Product Managers and building high\-performing product teams.
* Background in infrastructure, construction, capital program management, or related domains strongly preferred.
* Experience in North American markets is a strong advantage.

title: Associate Director - Category Demand Management

 Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e\-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.
 



 We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that
 



 empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit. Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self\-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.
 



 We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
 



 From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us. Working at Myntra is challenging but fun \- we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in
 



 meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams
 



 with the right tools, space, and opportunities.
 



  





 Job Summary :
 



  





 We are looking for a dynamic and analytical leader to head the Sell Side for one of our highest
 



 engagement categories: Sports, Footwear, and Athleisure.
 



 As the Associate Director, you will own the P\&L, drive revenue growth, and shape the consumer journey on the platform. You will be responsible for orchestrating the "Demand" side of the business—ensuring the right products get the right visibility at the right price. You will lead a high\-performing team of 6\+ members and collaborate extensively with central marketing, product, and revenue teams.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



  





 1\. P\&L Ownership \& Revenue Growth
 



 ● Revenue Management: Own the top\-line and bottom\-line growth for the category. Define
 



 monthly, quarterly, and annual operating plans.
 



 ● Growth Hacking: Drive consistent Year\-on\-Year (YoY) growth by balancing Consumer Acquisition
 



 (new users) and Retention (repeat purchase frequency).
 



 ● Pricing Strategy: Develop and execute dynamic pricing strategies. Balance competitiveness with

title: Manager/Senior Manager - Quantitative Research
description:
**Manager / Senior Manager – Quantitative Research (Individual Contributor)**
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Consumer\-Centric Finance**
 At CoinDCX, our mission is to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian by building products that are secure, intuitive, and trusted.
   

  

 As crypto evolves from an early\-adopter category to mainstream finance, every product decision, marketing investment, and strategic bet needs to be rooted in a deep understanding of customer behaviour. While analytics tells us what customers are doing, research helps us understand why\-and more importantly, what they are likely to do next.
   

  

 Our Consumer Insights team sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Design, Strategy, Analytics, and the Founder's Office. We help the organisation make smarter, customer\-first decisions by combining behavioural data with robust research and turning complexity into actionable business insights.
   

  

 This role sits at the heart of that mission, helping CoinDCX build a scalable consumer intelligence capability that informs product innovation, brand strategy, customer growth, and long\-term business decisions.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly analytical, business\-oriented Quantitative Research professional to join our central Consumer Insights team.
   

  

 You will be responsible for leading end\-to\-end quantitative research programmes that generate actionable customer intelligence across product, brand, and business domains. From identifying market opportunities and tracking customer behaviour to evaluating product performance and measuring brand health, your work will directly influence how CoinDCX builds products and grows its customer base.
   

  

 This role is critical to driving evidence\-based decision\-making across:
   

  

 Customer understanding and segmentation
   

  

 Product strategy and feature prioritisation
   

  

 Brand health and marketing effectiveness
   

  

 Customer experience measurement
   

  

 Business strategy and market opportunity identification
   

  

 You will work closely with Product, Marketing, Design, Strategy, Analytics, and the Founder's Office to ensure customer understanding becomes a core input into every major business decision.
   

  

**Why This Role Exists**
 CoinDCX generates millions of customer interactions every day.
   

  

 Analytics helps us measure behaviour.
   

  

 Quantitative research helps us understand the attitudes, motivations, perceptions, and unmet needs that drive those behaviours.
   

  

 As the business continues to scale, there is an increasing need for robust consumer intelligence that helps teams make confident decisions rather than relying on assumptions.
   

  

 There is a critical need for someone who can:
   

  

 Design scalable research programmes that continuously monitor customer, product, and brand health.
   

  

 Translate complex business questions into rigorous research frameworks.
   

  

 Combine research findings with behavioural and business data to generate richer customer insights.
   

  

 Identify emerging customer trends, market opportunities, and growth levers.
   

  

 Influence strategic decisions through clear, data\-driven storytelling.
   

  

 This role ensures that customer understanding becomes a strategic asset that guides product development, brand building, and business growth.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Customer \& Market Intelligence**
 Lead end\-to\-end quantitative research projects from business problem definition through stakeholder recommendations.
   

  

 Design and execute research across customer, product, and brand domains.
   

  

**Lead studies including:**
 Usage \& Attitude (U\&A) Studies
   

  

 Customer Segmentation
   

  

 Brand Tracking
   

  

 Product Tracking
   

  

 Customer Satisfaction \& Experience Measurement
   

  

 Concept \& Proposition Testing
   

  

 Market Opportunity Studies
   

  

 Ad\-hoc Quantitative Research
   

  

 Develop scalable tracking programmes that provide continuous visibility into changing customer behaviour.
   

  

**Data Analysis \& Insight Generation**
 Analyse survey data and behavioural datasets to identify meaningful customer patterns.
   

  

 Partner with Analytics teams to combine research findings with product and business metrics.
   

  

 Translate complex datasets into clear business narratives and strategic recommendations.
   

  

 Develop dashboards, trackers, and frameworks that democratise customer insights across the organisation.
   

  

**Business Partnership**
 Partner with Product, Marketing, Design, Strategy, Analytics, and Leadership teams to frame business questions into research problems.
   

  

 Provide research\-led recommendations that influence roadmap prioritisation, marketing strategy, customer acquisition, and retention initiatives.
   

  

 Support experimentation by evaluating customer response to new products, propositions, and experiences.
   

  

 Champion evidence\-based decision\-making across the organisation.
   

  

**Research Excellence \& Capability Building**
 Establish scalable quantitative research programmes and best practices.
   

  

 Improve research speed and efficiency through AI\-enabled workflows.
   

  

 Build repeatable frameworks for tracking customer, product, and brand performance over time.
   

  

 Continuously evolve the organisation's consumer intelligence capability.
   

  

**You'll Excel in This Role If You Have**
**Core Requirements**
 5–7 years of experience in quantitative research.
   

  

 Mandatory experience working with leading research agencies such as Kantar, Ipsos, NielsenIQ, GfK, or similar organisations for at least 3–4 years.
   

  

 Preferably followed by experience within a consumer\-facing brand, fintech, technology company, or high\-growth startup.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience designing and executing large\-scale quantitative research programmes.
   

  

 Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to identify meaningful customer patterns within large datasets.
   

  

 Excellent storytelling skills with the ability to translate numbers into business decisions.
   

  

 Experience working closely with Analytics and Data Science teams.
   

  

 Strong stakeholder management and project management capabilities.
   

  

 Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

  

**Preferred**
 Experience in fintech, investing, trading, crypto, or other high\-involvement consumer categories.
   

  

 Familiarity with behavioural analytics and experimentation.
   

  

 Experience using AI tools to accelerate research design, analysis, reporting, and insight generation.
   

  

 Exposure to advanced quantitative methodologies, statistical analysis, or modelling techniques.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
 Customer \& Market Intelligence
   

  

 Data Storytelling \& Insight Generation
   

  

 Strategic Business Thinking
   

  

 Quantitative Research Design
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

 Analytical Rigour \& Structured Problem Solving
   

  

 AI\-Enabled Research Workflows
   

  

 Ownership \& Commercial Acumen
   

  

**You'll Know You're Winning When**
 Stakeholders proactively rely on research before making strategic decisions.
   

  

 Customer tracking programmes become the single source of truth for customer, product, and brand health.
   

  

 Product and Marketing teams consistently use research findings to shape roadmaps and campaigns.
   

  

 Research findings are integrated with behavioural analytics to generate richer business insights.
   

  

 Research delivery becomes faster and more scalable through AI\-enabled workflows.
   

  

 Customer understanding becomes embedded across planning, prioritisation, and decision\-making.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
 A robust quantitative consumer intelligence capability that continuously informs strategic decisions.
   

  

 Product, Marketing, and Leadership teams confidently use research as a foundation for decision\-making.
   

  

 Customer, product, and brand tracking programmes become institutionalised across the business.
   

  

 Research consistently identifies growth opportunities, validates strategic bets, and reduces decision\-making risk.
   

  

 The voice of the customer is represented in every significant product, marketing, and business decision.
   

  

**Hiring Process**
 Here's what your interview journey with CoinDCX looks like:
   

  

 Application Review
   

  

 Recruiter Connect
   

  

 Quantitative Research Case Study \& Discussion
   

  

 Hiring Manager Round
   

  

 Culture \& Values Discussion
   

  

**Ready to Help Build the Future of Customer\-Centric Finance?**
 If you're passionate about uncovering patterns in customer behaviour, transforming data into strategic decisions, and building one of India's most impactful Consumer Insights functions, this role puts you at the centre of CoinDCX's most important business decisions.
   

  

 Join CoinDCX and help shape the future of customer\-led innovation in digital finance.

In this role, you will drive the integration of sustainability into the design, performance, and lifecycle of industry\-leading semiconductor equipment. By partnering with engineering, product, and business teams globally, you will translate complex technical data into actionable insights that reduce environmental impact, support customer sustainability goals, and accelerate Lam's journey toward a lower\-carbon future.

**What You'll Do**

 In this role, your role is to capture this opportunity to deliver the next generation of the Memories experience. You will build a system that understands what's in each user's library and the context of what's going on in their life, and adapts to deliver the right moments at the right time, in formats that are fresh and engaging for that user.

 You will own the product direction and roadmap for foundational capabilities such as repository and data services, workflow, search, APIs, and other shared platform services used across multiple Esko products. You will work closely with Architects, Engineering leaders, and Product Managers to identify common platform needs, establish priorities, drive adoption, and translate platform strategy into an executable roadmap.

* Define success measures and use adoption, usage, developer experience, reliability, and business outcomes to guide platform investments.

* Cloud Platform Services have a clear strategy, roadmap, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* Product teams understand what the platform provides, how to consume it, and where ownership boundaries lie.
* Shared platform capabilities evolve based on common product needs, adoption, and long\-term platform strategy.

 You will keep stakeholders updated as work progresses, then support them through acceptance testing, triage and implement change requests, and drive adoption of the services in production. title: Users Retention Manager (Product Growth)
description:
**Retention Manager – Product Growth** 




 Location: Bangalore (Office – HSR Layout)
 



 Department: CRM / Growth
 



  





**About AppsForBharat** 




 AppsForBharat (Sri Mandir App) is building beautifully crafted, AI\-first consumer experiences that help millions of Indians connect with spirituality and culture. We’re backed by Peak XV Partners, Elevation, Fundamentum, and other top\-tier investors, and are one of India’s fastest\-growing Series C consumer\-tech companies.
 



 Our flagship product, Sri Mandir, is the world’s largest platform for Hindu devotees, powering rituals, teachings, personalized recommendations, and a thriving devotional community. India’s $44B devotion economy is still largely offline, and we’re bringing structure, accessibility, and meaning to this massive market, where design and data play a central role in shaping user behavior at scale.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a Retention Manager – Product Growth to own one of our most important growth problems: how do we get users to come back, transact more frequently, and build a long\-term relationship with Sri Mandir?
 



 This role sits at the intersection of Product, Growth, CRM and Data. You will use user behaviour, cohort insights and experimentation to identify retention opportunities and turn them into scalable product, engagement and lifecycle interventions.
 



 This is not a traditional CRM/campaign role. You will own the retention problem, while working with Product, CRM, Data, Design and Business teams to determine the right levers to solve it.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* **Retention Strategy:** 
 Build and drive the retention roadmap across new, repeat, dormant and high\-value user cohorts.
* **User \& Behaviour Insights:** 
 Deep\-dive into user behaviour, cohorts, frequency, repeat patterns and LTV to identify the biggest retention opportunities.
* **Product\-led Retention:** 
 Design and scale interventions such as subscriptions, loyalty/reward systems, personalisation, pricing/discounting and repeat\-use experiences.
* **Experimentation:** 
 Build a continuous experimentation pipeline — identify hypotheses, define success metrics, launch experiments and measure incremental impact.
* **Reactivation \& Frequency:** 
 Identify opportunities to bring dormant users back and increase the frequency of existing users through product and engagement interventions.
* **Cross\-functional Execution:** 
 Partner closely with Product, CRM, Data, Design and Business teams to take retention initiatives from insight → PRD/experiment → launch → measurement → scale.
* **Retention Measurement:** 
 Build frameworks to understand the impact of retention initiatives on repeat rate, frequency, revenue, contribution margin and LTV.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Diagnose Retention Problems** 



* Analyse retention and repeat behaviour across user, category, product, deity, geography, platform, acquisition source and other relevant dimensions.
* Identify where and why users drop off across their lifecycle.
* Translate data into clear behavioural insights and actionable opportunities.



**2\. Build Retention Solutions** 



* Convert insights into product, loyalty, personalisation and lifecycle hypotheses.
* Work with Product and CRM teams to design solutions that address specific user needs and behavioural gaps.
* Prioritise opportunities based on expected user and business impact.



**3\. Run a Strong Experimentation Engine** 



* Own the retention experimentation roadmap.
* Define hypotheses, control/treatment groups, success metrics and measurement frameworks.
* Evaluate experiments based on
 **incremental impact** 
 , not just engagement metrics.
* Scale successful interventions and quickly learn from unsuccessful ones.



**4\. Improve Repeat \& Lifetime Value** 



* Develop strategies to increase repeat transactions and user frequency.
* Identify opportunities to move users from first transaction → repeat → high\-frequency behaviour.
* Build interventions that improve long\-term user value rather than short\-term conversion alone.



**5\. Build Retention Intelligence** 



* Develop and maintain retention dashboards and reporting frameworks for daily/weekly decision\-making.
* Track key metrics including retention, repeat rate, frequency, reactivation and LTV.
* Establish clear measurement frameworks for major retention initiatives.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* **6–8 years of experience** 
 in growth, retention, product growth, lifecycle, consumer internet or related roles.
* Strong experience solving
 **consumer retention and engagement problems** 
 through data and experimentation.
* Strong analytical ability with hands\-on experience in
 **cohort analysis, funnel analysis, retention metrics and LTV/business impact analysis** 
 .
* Strong product sense — able to identify user problems and translate them into product or growth opportunities.
* Experience running
 **A/B tests and growth experiments** 
 end\-to\-end.
* Understanding of CRM/lifecycle marketing and how communication can complement product\-led retention.
* Comfortable working with
 **SQL, product analytics and dashboards** 
 such as Mixpanel, Metabase, Superset or equivalent tools.
* Strong cross\-functional skills — able to work effectively with Product, Data, Design, CRM and Business teams.
* Bias towards action, experimentation and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and independently identify and solve high\-impact problems.



  





**What Will Make You Successful** 




 You should naturally think in a loop:
 



**Understand user behaviour → Identify the retention problem → Form a hypothesis → Build the right intervention → Experiment → Measure incremental impact → Scale** 




 You should be equally comfortable discussing:
 


* Why a user did not return
* What behavioural segment is most valuable
* What product change could improve repeat behaviour
* Whether a subscription/loyalty intervention will actually create incremental retention
* How CRM can amplify a product intervention
* Whether an experiment genuinely moved LTV or simply shifted existing demand



  





**Key Deliverables** 



* **Retention Opportunity Roadmap** 
 across new, repeat, dormant and high\-value cohorts
* **Retention \& Cohort Intelligence Dashboard** 
 for ongoing decision\-making
* Continuous
 **Retention Experimentation Pipeline** 
 with clear hypotheses and measurement
* Successful rollout and optimisation of
 **product\-led retention initiatives**
* Measurable improvement in
 **repeat rate, retention, frequency, reactivation and LTV**
* Clear post\-launch measurement and learning framework for all major retention initiatives



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 Sri Mandir serves users across very different spiritual needs, behaviours and frequencies. The next phase of growth is not only about acquiring more users — it is about
 **understanding what brings users back and building experiences that make the next spiritual action easier, more relevant and more meaningful.** 




 This role will be at the centre of that problem —
 **building the systems, insights and experiments that turn one\-time users into long\-term users.** 




  





**One Team. One Goal. Assisting millions on their digital devotional journeys**

title: Senior Product Manager, Growth (Based in Dubai)
description:
**DUBAI BASED ROLE.** 
 Relocation would be required but with highly competitive, tax free salary package.
 



  





**Company Profile:** 




  





 Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.
 



 Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.
 



  





**Role Summary:** 




  





 Property Finder is the leading property portal in the UAE and MENA, and one of the most visited Real Estate destinations in the region. Millions of people use it every month to find a home, and most of them arrive because the product itself brought them there.
 



 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our product\-led growth work: making the product easier to discover, faster to get value from, more rewarding to come back to, and something people want to share. You will lead a cross\-functional squad, own the roadmap, and be accountable for the results.
 



 This is a senior, hands\-on role for a rare kind of generalist: someone with a quantitative mind, real depth across product, SEO, performance marketing, research, data and engineering, and the taste and presence to carry a growth story from a spreadsheet to the executive room.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Own and lead the product\-led growth roadmap, from discovery to delivery to results.
* Grow the product's organic reach: the pages, tools and content surfaces that make Property Finder the place people land when they search for anything to do with property, including through AI assistants.
* Make the product shareable and viral. Build the moments people want to send to a partner, a friend or a colleague, and make sharing effortless.
* Design first sessions that get new visitors to value quickly, and experiences that bring people back throughout their property journey.
* Bring engagement and gamification into the product with taste: recognition, progress and reward that feel natural in a high\-stakes decision like finding a home.
* Turn user contributions into product: reviews, questions, opinions and local knowledge that make the product richer for everyone.
* Run a disciplined experimentation programme: hypotheses, guardrails, clean reads and honest write\-ups when a test loses.
* Work hand in hand with performance marketing so paid and organic reinforce each other rather than compete.
* Use AI as a working method, not a slide: research, analysis, prototyping, content and data workflows.
* Lead the squad day to day: prioritisation, specs, experiments, readouts and shipped work.
* Work closely with SEO, Data Science, Engineering, Design, Analytics and Marketing, and keep growth on the consumer side aligned with the business.
* Communicate crisply with senior stakeholders and represent the growth story across the company.



  





**Desired Experience:** 




  




* You have built products that grew on their own having spread through its own users and search, and you can explain what worked, what did not, and why.
* Eight or more years in product, most of it on consumer products at scale, with at least three in a growth role where you owned the number.
* Quantitative by training. A degree in mathematics, physics, engineering, computer science or a similar discipline, ideally with an MBA or comparable business education on top.
* First principles reasoning and you are comfortable with models.
* End to end knowledge. Discovery, user research, specs, prioritisation, experimentation and readouts.
* You have designed and read A/B tests properly, including the messy ones with lag, seasonality and interference, and you know when not to trust a result.
* Hands\-on with SEO. Technical, content and off\-page.
* You have worked in Search Console and crawl data yourself, shipped templated pages at scale, and understand how search engines and AI assistants source and cite answers.
* Deep understanding of performance marketing. Paid search, paid social and app campaigns: how they are bought, measured and attributed, and how they interact with organic.
* User research. Interviews, surveys, usability sessions and behavioural analysis, and you know which one answers which question.
* Strong with data. SQL and product analytics as a daily habit, statistics you can apply rather than recite, and dashboards you built yourself.
* You can code and you speak engineering. Python or JavaScript well enough to pull data, prototype a feature or automate a workflow, and enough architecture to have a real conversation about trade\-offs and effort. Engineers trust your judgement.
* AI skills. You use LLMs and agents as a working method for research, analysis, prototyping and content, you have built or orchestrated agentic workflows, and you have a grounded view of where they help and where they hurt.
* You can take a complex story to an executive room, hold attention, answer the hard question and leave with a decision.



  





**Nice to have:** 




  




* Marketplace experience where you have worked on a two\-sided product and know that growth on one side has consequences on the other.
* Real Estate, classifieds or marketplace background in the UAE or GCC.
* Experience with user\-generated content, loyalty or gamification products, or App Store Optimisation.
* Arabic language skills



  





**Why this role?** 




  




* Scale and stakes: millions of monthly users, the leading position in the market, and a mandate to extend it.
* Real ownership: a squad, a roadmap and a budget conversation that are yours to shape.
* A team that treats growth as a product discipline, not a marketing tactic, and works with data science and engineering as peers.
* Direct exposure to the executive team, and a manager who expects you to disagree with him when the evidence says so.

title: Engineering Manager - Nonlinear Productivity (Friction Elimination & Solutions)
description:

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**An Overview Of This Role**
 As Manager, Engineering, Nonlinear Productivity (Friction Elimination \& Solutions), you’ll help GitLab break the linear relationship between headcount and engineering output. In this role, you’ll oversee the initiative’s forward\-scanning work, reviewing GitLab’s software development lifecycle and code\-generation workflows to spot recurring friction, test durable fixes, and identify internal solutions that could become customer\-facing products.
   

  

 You’ll report to the Senior Manager or Director, Nonlinear Productivity and work at the intersection of engineering, developer productivity, AI\-assisted development, and product. You’ll build a data\-backed view of where technical interventions can have the highest leverage, test solutions through prototypes, drive validated fixes into internal adoption, and help build the case for productizing the strongest outcomes.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Survey GitLab’s internal software development lifecycle and code\-generation workflows to identify structural friction early, and build a data\-backed view of where technical interventions will have the highest leverage.
* Evaluate build, buy, and adapt options for each opportunity, including emerging agentic and AI tooling, with a clear view of cost, risk, and durability.
* Stand up prototypes and review architecture directly to test whether a proposed fix moves a target metric and represents a durable solution before GitLab makes broader engineering investment.
* Hire and manage a small, high\-caliber team, or operate as a hands\-on working manager, with a focus on talent density over headcount.
* Drive validated fixes from prototype to internal adoption by partnering with affected teams so solutions are relied on, used, and maintained.
* Build the technical and business case for productizing internal fixes that prove durable, in partnership with product.
* Document reusable learnings so successful internal fixes don’t remain tribal knowledge.
* Report impact through changes in key metrics and progress on turning internal fixes into products, including a clear account of what didn’t work.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Ability to use GitLab.
* A track record of identifying and shipping technical fixes for developer productivity, continuous integration and continuous delivery, or platform friction, including problems you found before they were assigned.
* Comfort operating with high ambiguity and no existing backlog, building the roadmap rather than executing one handed down.
* People management experience, including in a small\-team or working\-manager capacity.
* Technical depth to evaluate and prototype solutions directly, not only direct others toward them.
* Product judgment to assess whether an internal tool could hold up for paying customers.
* Familiarity with agentic or AI\-assisted development tooling.
* Experience moving an internal tool toward an external, customer\-facing product is advantageous.


**About The Team**
 The Nonlinear Productivity team improves how GitLab engineers, and increasingly agents, build, review, and ship code. We test and scale durable technical fixes that improve our internal engineering output.
   

  

**Career ladder**
 In this role, you can progress to Senior Manager, Nonlinear Productivity, with an expanded mandate across the full set of team metrics we use to track improvement.
   

  

 Additional details about our process can be found on our hiring page.

description:
**Company Description**
 It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic\-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
   

  

 We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
   

  

 The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
   

  

 If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Primary Function of Position**
 The Sr Business System Analyst will act as Workday Systems Analyst/Developer and possess both the functional \& technical understanding of Workday HCM and will serve as primary source for Tier 2/Tier 3 technical support, configuration, and development of interfaces and functional enhancements.
   

  

**Essential Job Duties**
* Translate business requirements into well architected solutions that best leverage Workday platform.
* Configure and design Workday HCM functional areas including core HCM, absence, benefits, compensation, business process and security.
* Troubleshoot, develop, and maintain integration systems across the Workday integration’s platform.
* Involve in building and debugging custom reports, EIBs, connectors, document transforms, XSLT, calculated fields, BIRT, and Workday studio.
* Analyze business processes, perform fit\-gap analysis as required, and provide ISI business teams with cost efficient proposal on inefficiencies and risks to determine appropriate process and system design.
* Create functional specifications and work with cross\-functional teams and development teams to deliver the technical objects.
* Review and contribute to design document, configuration documents and functional specifications.
* Conduct Unit testing Integration testing, Regression testing and User acceptance testing.
* Support ISI’s production processes and all associated business systems functions.
* Work with ISI IT and business teams to optimize and streamline business processes and technical solutions.
* Identify gaps between current and future state of business processes and helps in prioritizing opportunities to improving processes through the usage of Business capability matrix (BCM)
* Lead and facilitate business user meetings to gather process information for sound system solutions.
* Collaborate and provide inputs to the development team during development phase to meet the business needs.
* Conduct unit and Integration testing and regression testing.
* Maintain IT Business system integrity and application notes, system upgrades, changes, and user updates.
* Work closely with onsite team, offshore team, managers, and executives to ensure the release of high\-quality solutions.
* Follow the Intuitive change management process. Analyze impact of changes to the corporate application landscape
* Act as Senior BA and guide \& mentor the team members in providing best solutions and do peer review and advice on areas of improvement.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Minimum 8 years of experience working on the Workday platform with Business Systems Analyst / Development experience in a full cycle implementation as well as in support role.
* Strong experience with Workday project implementations and Workday integrations platform including integrations with ERP and third\-party applications.
* Hands\-on experience with configuration of new and existing Workday features including user management, roles/profiles, permission, custom objects, new page layouts, custom fields, calculated fields, conditions rules, validations, business process and notifications.
* Experience working with business end users, gathering requirements, and building detailed functional design specifications.
* Experience building and debugging custom reports, EIBs, connectors, document transforms, XSLT, calculated fields, BIRT, and Workday studio.
* Experience collaborating with Integration resources in a highly integrated system landscape.
* Workday Pro Certifications – Integrations and HCM preferred.
* Ability to work with minimum supervision or guidance.
* Ability to work in a team environment, effectively interacting with others.
* Ability to multi\-task and perform effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to guide team members and mentor them as needed.
* Able to work independently and consider cross\-functional and downstream impacts with close attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills both written and oral, interpersonal, organizational skills, and problem\-solving ability to work with non\-technical end users.


**Qualifications**
**Required Education and Training**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent experience.


**Preferred Skills And Experience**
 Must have Skills
   

  

* Strong experience with Workday project implementations and Workday integrations platform including integrations with ERP and third\-party applications.
* Hands\-on experience with configuration of new and existing Workday features including user management, roles/profiles, permission, custom objects, new page layouts, custom fields, calculated fields, conditions rules, validations, business process and notifications.


 Additional Information
   

  

 Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.
   

  

 We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.
   

  

 U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR
   

  

* 743\.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.


 Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6\+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).
   

  

 For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.
