title: Assurance - Financial Market - Kyriba – Senior Associate
description:
At PwC, our people in finance consulting specialise in providing consulting services related to financial management and strategy. These individuals analyse client needs, develop financial solutions, and offer guidance and support to help clients optimise their financial performance, improve decision\-making, and achieve their financial goals.
   

  

 As a finance consulting generalist at PwC, you will possess a broad understanding of various aspects of finance consulting. Your work will involve providing comprehensive guidance and support to clients in optimising their financial performance, improving decision\-making, and achieving their financial goals. You will be responsible for analysing client needs, developing financial solutions, and offering recommendations tailored to specific business requirements.
   

  

 Focused on relationships, you are building meaningful client connections, and learning how to manage and inspire others. Navigating increasingly complex situations, you are growing your personal brand, deepening technical expertise and awareness of your strengths. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality. Embracing increased ambiguity, you are comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, you ask questions, and you use these moments as opportunities to grow.
   

  

**Skills**
 Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
   

  

* Respond effectively to the diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.
* Use a broad range of tools, methodologies and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems.
* Use critical thinking to break down complex concepts.
* Understand the broader objectives of your project or role and how your work fits into the overall strategy.
* Develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is changing.
* Use reflection to develop self awareness, enhance strengths and address development areas.
* Interpret data to inform insights and recommendations.
* Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.


**Responsibilities**
 As a Senior Associate, you'll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues. PwC Professional skills and responsibilities for this management level include but are not limited to:
   

  

* Lead or support Kyriba implementation projects from initiation to go\-live, ensuring timely and successful delivery.
* Gather and analyze business requirements related to cash management, payments, debt, investments, and risk.
* Configure Kyriba modules to support client business processes including Cash \& Liquidity, Payments, Forecasting, Accounting, Bank Connectivity, and Risk Management.
* Coordinate with client stakeholders, banks, and Kyriba support for integrations and testing.
* Design and deliver training sessions and user documentation for client teams.
* Conduct UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and assist in change management processes.
* Provide post\-go\-live support, troubleshoot issues, and offer continuous improvement recommendations.
* Act as a subject matter expert on best practices in treasury operations and Kyriba system capabilities.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including finance, IT, and third\-party vendors.
* Demonstrating extensive abilities and/or a proven record of success as a team member in a professional services consulting firm, including, but not limited to, the following areas:
* Demonstrating extensive knowledge of hedging strategies and application of hedge accounting requirements under US GAAP/IFRS;
* Demonstrating significant experience valuing derivatives, including interest rate swaps, FX, options, forward contracts, swaps, etc.;
* financial instruments hedging, treasury and derivatives accounting, embedded derivatives;
* complex transactions in new and established products through an understanding of complex and/or new accounting and tax standards;
* Understanding business intelligence and performance management software tools; – Understanding software implementation phases, including unit testing, systems integration and user acceptance testing
* Being Proficient in utilizing technology and industry software for efficient financial analysis and reporting.
* Upholding the firm's code of ethics and business conduct.


**Must\-have**
* Experience with multi\-entity or global treasury implementations
* Knowledge of treasury regulations and compliance standards (SOX, KYC, etc.).
* Excellent problem\-solving, project management, and communication skills.
* Team player, committed to providing high quality work and maintaining timeliness
* Demonstrate self\-motivation and a desire to take responsibility for personal growth and development
* Commitment to continuous training and to proactively learn new processes Preferred


**Years Of Experience**
 Minimum 3 years experience certified in Core Kyriba Course (Cash Management Certification
   

  

**Good\-to\-have**
* Basic understanding of corporate financial statements and various types of securities/Financial Instruments
* Playing a role in discussions, proactively ask questions and share an informed point of view
* Strong understanding of TMS modules such as cash positioning, forecasting, in\-house banking, payments, and accounting integration.
* Experience in ERP integration (SAP, Oracle, etc.) and bank connectivity (SWIFT, API, H2H).


**Education Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Real Estate, Engineering (of any discipline), Geoinformatics, Business Administration, Information Technology
* B.COM, B.Tech, B.SC, BBA


**Credentials**
* CTP (Certified Treasury Professional) CPA, CA, CFA, CAIA, FRM, Master’s in relevant field of expertise or MBA, or PGDBM in Finance from premium institutes only


**Certifications**
* Core Kyriba certification (Cash Management Certification)

title: Lead Application Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design\-Trade\-off\-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
   

  

 Verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung des Abteilungsbetriebs oder konzentriert sich auf die Ausführung von beruflichen Tätigkeiten innerhalb einer technischen Disziplin.Hat eine gewisse Autonomie, wird jedoch von festgelegten Richtlinien oder der Überprüfung der Endergebnisse geleitet.
   

  

 Die Stelle ermöglicht die Änderung von Arbeitsabläufen und Praktiken, sofern die Endergebnisse den Standards der Akzeptanz (Qualität, Umfang, Aktualität usw.) entsprechen.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**
* Führt Komponenten\- und Produktintegration durch. Alle Aktivitäten, die mehrere Komponenten und Produkte umfassen und sich mit der Integration für maximale Leistung und Bedienbarkeit befassen. Verwaltet Produkt\- und Systemanforderungen, Spezifikationen und den Datenfluss. Führt Validierungs\- und Verifizierungsaktivitäten für das gesamte Produkt/System durch, einschließlich Tests auf Systemebene. Verantwortlich für die Definition der Produktanforderungen für das Modul/die Komponente/Subunternehmer und Partnerteams. Verwaltet die Schnittstelle zwischen Komponenten und Ausführungsorganisationen. Verantwortlich für das Vorantreiben von CTQ/Risk\-Trades innerhalb der Teams, die die Komponenten entwerfen. Verwaltet die Gesamtproduktkonfiguration und das Konfigurationssteuerungssystem.
* Nutzt vertiefte Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin sowie analytisches Denken und technische Erfahrung zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien.
* Hat Kenntnisse über Best Practices und darüber, wie sich der eigene Bereich in andere integriert; ist sich des Wettbewerbs und der Faktoren bewusst, die das Unternehmen auf dem Markt auszeichnen
* Nutzt ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, um kompliziertere Herstellungsprozesse mit technischer Vielfalt und/oder voneinander abhängigen Produktionszyklen anzugehen.Verwendet technische Erfahrung und analytisches Denken.Verwendet mehrere interne und begrenzte externe Quellen außerhalb der eigenen Teams, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
* Dient als Ressource für Kollegen mit weniger Erfahrung.Kann kleine Projekte mit geringen Risiken und Ressourcenanforderungen leiten.Erklärt Informationen; Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten, um Teammitglieder zu einem Konsens über Themen innerhalb des Feldes zu bewegen.Vermittelt Leistungserwartungen und kann vertrauliche Themen behandeln.


**Grundqualifikationen**
* Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor\-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).


**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**
* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Tech & Data - AI Generalist - Manager
description:
At PwC, our people in audit and assurance focus on providing independent and objective assessments of financial statements, internal controls, and other assurable information enhancing the credibility and reliability of this information with a variety of stakeholders. They evaluate compliance with regulations including assessing governance and risk management processes and related controls.
   

  

 Those in data, analytics and technology solutions at PwC will assist clients in developing solutions that help build trust, drive improvement, and detect, monitor, and predict risk. Your work will involve using advanced analytics, data wrangling technology, and automation tools to leverage data and focus on establishing the right processes and structures to enable our clients to make efficient and effective decisions based on accurate information that is complete and trustworthy.
   

  

 Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team member’s unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
   

  

**Skills**
 Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
   

  

* Analyse and identify the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system.
* Take ownership of projects, ensuring their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
* Partner with team leadership to ensure collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables.
* Develop skills outside your comfort zone, and encourage others to do the same.
* Effectively mentor others.
* Use the review of work as an opportunity to deepen the expertise of team members.
* Address conflicts or issues, engaging in difficult conversations with clients, team members and other stakeholders, escalating where appropriate.


 Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
* When you join PwC Acceleration Centers (ACs), you step into a pivotal role focused on actively supporting various Acceleration Center services, from Advisory to Assurance, Tax and Business Services. In our innovative hubs, you’ll engage in challenging projects and provide distinctive services to support client engagements through enhanced quality and innovation. You’ll also participate in dynamic and digitally enabled training that is designed to grow your technical and professional skills.
* As part of the Tech \& Data team you lead the design, development, and deployment of AI\-driven solutions that address complex business challenges. As a Manager you inspire and mentor team members while overseeing the execution of AI engagements, maintaining quality and adherence to timelines in alignment with PwC's standards of excellence. This role offers the chance to work closely with global engagement teams and clients, driving innovation and delivering impactful results in a dynamic consulting environment.


**Responsibilities**
* Lead client\-facing discussions to gather requirements
* Facilitate workshops to translate business challenges
* Oversee the execution of AI engagements while maintaining quality
* Develop actionable AI architecture and delivery plans
* Maintain adherence to timelines and project standards
* Collaborate with teams to drive successful outcomes
* Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project
* Uphold PwC’s standards of excellence in every deliverable


**What You Must Have**
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics
* 9\-14 years of experience in relevant roles, preferably in a public accounting firm or a large corporation
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


**What Sets You Apart**
* Certifications such as Azure AI Engineer, CISA, Certified Public Accountant (partial), or relevant data science/cloud certifications
* Proven experience designing and scaling AI/ML solutions
* Skilled in the entire ML lifecycle
* Excelling in analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Managing complex stakeholder relationships
* Thriving in dynamic consulting environments
* Supporting Engagement Managers in project planning

title: PLM & Change Management Engineer II
description:
**At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.**
**Job Overview**
**BU / FUNCTION DESCRIPTION**
 TE Energy offers a wide range of reliable and cost\-effective products for the electrical power industry. Our position as a leading supplier of electrical components enables us to design next\-generation products. For over 60 years, we have worked closely with our customers around the globe to develop innovative solutions to ever\-changing challenges, known under names such as, Bowthorpe EMP, Crompton Instruments, Raychem, Simel, Kries, Harger and Richard Manufacturing
   

  

**ROLE OBJECTIVE**
 Project Manager Engineer is responsible for driving Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) activities for Energy BU. The role represents the business in global PLM forums, leads projects related to PLM, data management, and environmental compliance, and works closely with cross‑functional teams to define initiatives, gather requirements, and ensure successful delivery.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement PLM and data management processes, tools, methods, and standards.
* Lead and coordinate medium‑complexity projects related to PLM, environmental compliance, and data management.
* Prepare process documentation and deliver training to support PLM initiatives.
* Represent the Business Unit in Digital Part Management and Digital Marketing discussions.
* Act as engineering release and change management process owner for the BU.
* Drive engineering systems and application rollouts, manage risks, and negotiate trade‑offs to meet project goals.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement in PLM and PEC initiatives
* Excellent leadership ability to manage cross functional project execution.


**Desired Candidate Profile**
* Bachelor’s Degree or above in Engineering or equivalent program
* Formal project management education/PMP certification.
* Continuous improvement/ Kaizen facilitator experience. Green belt is a plus.
* 7\+ years’ of experience in Product Life cycle management and Project management
* 5 years’ experience working in/with engineering
* Solid understanding of Engineering tools, Engineering Change Management, Bill of Materials
* Knowledge of Creo and PDM\-Link
* Data Analysis, Data mining and reporting experience
* Excellent in English (verbal/written)
* Excellent communication, presentation skills
* Excellent in MS office, excel, PowerPoint
* Critical thinking, problem solving
* Experience leading global teams, including matrix assignment
* Flexible, result oriented, goal driven, team player


**What Your Background Should Look Like**
 Generally requires Bachelors degree in appropriate field or local equivalent with a minimum of 3 years of progressively responsible professional level experience
   

  

**Competencies**
 SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)
   

  

**About Te Connectivity**
 TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next\-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.
   

  

 Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).
   

  

**What Te Connectivity Offers**
 We are pleased to offer you an exciting total package that can also be flexibly adapted to changing life situations \- the well\-being of our employees is our top priority!
   

  

* Unlimited contract opportunity
* Pleasant working environment fostering teamwork
* Open and dynamic company culture
* Extensive training initiatives and growth opportunities
* Competitive salary package
* Comprehensive benefits including Group insurance, Hospitalization insurance, Meal vouchers etc.
* Convenient location at E40 and E403 motorway intersection
* Join a certified "TOP EMPLOYER" in a modern "FACTORY OF THE FUTURE"


**IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
 TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity
 **never requests payment or fees** 
 from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come
 **only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com** 
 . If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.
   

  

 Across our global sites and business units, we put together packages of benefits that are either supported by TE itself or provided by external service providers. In principle, the benefits offered can vary from site to site.

title: Product Manager – Network Services
description:

 Experience: 9\+ Years
   

  

 Location: Bangalore/Hybrid
   

  

 Employment Type: Full Time
   

  

 We re hiring for one of the top IT services companies.
   

  

 SPADTEK Solutions is proud to collaborate with leading IT organizations to source exceptional talent for their full\-time and Contract positions. title: Internal Product Manager 3 - Sales Performance Management
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join Adobe’s Digital Experience organization in Bengaluru as a Product Manager 3 and lead one of our most important enterprise capabilities. You will manage forecasting within a connected ecosystem that includes Sales Performance Management, Forecasting, and upstream planning systems. This provides a single, reliable view of pipeline and ARR forecasts, which directly supports executive decision\-making. This outstanding opportunity lets you join a world\-class team and make a meaningful impact!
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Take full responsibility for Sales Performance Management and forecasting systems from start to finish
* Define product strategy and roadmap for pipeline visibility, forecast rollups, and data\-based predictions
* Lead cross\-system integration and architecture, ensuring scalable, reliable data flows
* Partner with Sales, RevOps, and Finance to align forecast definitions, pipeline stages, and revenue assumptions
* Improve forecast accuracy, pipeline coverage, and predictability through data insights
* Work with engineering teams to bring to bear AI/ML, LLMs, or automation frameworks (e.g., copilots, agents, orchestration tools)
* Proven capability to outline, convey, and secure agreement on multi\-year product roadmaps for platform or enterprise products


**Skills Required**
* 6–8 years in Product Management, ideally within Sales Performance Management, Forecasting, RevOps, or related platforms
* Experience owning complex, multi\-system enterprise products or SPM and Forecasting platforms
* Strong comprehension of sales pipeline oversight, sales performance tracking, and forecasting procedures
* Strong experience partnering with engineering, architecture, and operations teams in Agile/Scrum environments
* Experience managing complex, multi\-system initiatives through disciplined prioritization and execution
* Strong data and analytical abilities with experience working on data models, pipelines, and forecasting inputs
* Proven ability to drive cross\-functional alignment and roadmap execution at scale


 Requirements \& Product Discovery
   

  

* Strong ability to elicit, structure, and validate business requirements through interviews, workshops, and discovery sessions with collaborators, customers, and other interested parties
* Experience conducting fit\-gap analysis (current vs. future state) to define MVP scope and strategic roadmap
* Ability to challenge and refine requirements to ensure alignment with business value, outcomes, and scalability


 Documentation \& Communication
   

  

* Expertise in crafting clear, structured product artifacts, including:


 Product Requirements Documents (PRDs)
   

  

* Business Requirements Documents (BRDs)


 Process flows, journey maps, and personas
   

  

* Ability to detail end\-to\-end business processes and system interactions, including downstream impacts across coordinated platforms
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences


 Backlog Management \& Delivery Readiness
   

  

* Proven experience translating requirements into epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria
* Strong backlog ownership, including prioritization, refinement, and sprint readiness
* Ability to outline test scenarios and UAT criteria, ensuring delivered features meet business expectations

title: Senior Product Manager -Galleries
description:
**About Bazaarvoice**
 At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product\-passionate community \& enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. Our solutions enable brands to connect with consumers and collect valuable user\-generated content, at an unprecedented scale. This content achieves global reach by leveraging our extensive and ever\-expanding retail, social \& search syndication network. And we make it easy for brands \& retailers to gain valuable business insights from real\-time consumer feedback with intuitive tools and dashboards. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products.
   

  

 The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long\-term loyalty.
   

  

 Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers.
   

  

 Founded in 2005, Bazaarvoice is headquartered in Austin, Texas with offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.
   

  

 It’s official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!
   

  

**Job Description**
 At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Our mission is to build smarter shopper experiences across the entire customer journey — from discovery on social to conversion on the product page. Whether it's optimizing a shoppable gallery experience on a retailer PDP or scaling visual content distribution across a global brand\-retailer network, we're here to be a true strategic partner for businesses.
   

  

 As the Senior Product Manager responsible for Bazaarvoice Social Galleries and Visual Syndication Network, you will play a critical role in shaping how brands and retailers display and distribute visual user\-generated content at scale. Your primary focus will be on understanding the needs of brand marketers, retailer merchandising teams, and end shoppers — then building products that drive trust, engagement, and conversion through authentic visual experiences at every point of sale.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Defining a strategy and creating a 1–2 year roadmap for Social Galleries and Visual Syndication Network, balancing the needs of both sides of Bazaarvoice's brand\-retailer network.
* Knowing the pulse of the market: social commerce trends, visual UGC consumption behavior, and the competitive landscape of shoppable gallery and content syndication solutions.
* Serve as a product advocate for brands and retailers in discussions with clients, articulating how visual content display and distribution drive measurable lift in conversion and engagement.
* Discover and validate problems — from gallery rendering performance and shoppability on PDPs to syndication match rate gaps across the retailer network — through research, data analysis, and experimentation.
* Lead Product Discovery and Early Adopter Programs to validate display and distribution features iteratively with high\-value brand and retailer clients.
* Partner with Marketing and Sales to define product positioning, competitive differentiation, and pricing strategy for visual UGC display and syndication capabilities.
* Make prioritization decisions that balance syndication infrastructure reliability with shopper\-facing experience improvements — gallery rendering, shoppability, personalization, and placement flexibility.
* Own the full product lifecycle — from build through market testing, GTM launch, success narrative, and iterative enhancement. Evangelize product releases with data\-driven narratives connecting visual syndication volume and gallery engagement metrics to client ROI.
* Work with Technical Services and Product Knowledge teams to build internal training and external documentation for gallery and syndication capabilities. Communicate across teams to ensure consistent backlog alignment and that engineering has everything needed to size, accept, and execute on work.


**Essential Criteria**
* 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to content distribution networks, syndication platforms, or visual commerce display surfaces
* Strategic thinking with the ability to develop a roadmap that serves both brand and retailer stakeholders across a global visual syndication network
* Ability to prioritize across competing investments — syndication infrastructure reliability, retailer integration scalability, and shopper\-facing gallery experience improvements
* Understanding of content delivery, retailer API integrations, and the technical nuances of rendering visual assets at scale across heterogeneous retail environments
* Ability to define and track metrics like Syndication Match Rate, Visual Content Volume, Gallery Engagement Rate, and shoppability conversion lift
* Experience conducting market research, competitive analysis, and customer interviews in a B2B2C context
* Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity — retailer integration requirements vary widely and visual commerce display standards continue to evolve
* Familiarity with front\-end display performance considerations (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, responsive media) as they relate to gallery experience on retailer PDPs


 Why You’ll Love Working with Us?
   

  

* Work with cutting\-edge technology in a collaborative, global team
* Competitive salary \+ good benefits (insurance, annual leave, bonuses, referral rewards, and more).
* We’re Great Place to Work Certified (4 years in a row!).
* Hybrid work model (3 days in office – Prestige Tech Pacific).

title: Technical Product Owner - Salesforce Projects
description:
**India T\&M Special Bonus:**
 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Technical Product Owner to join our team in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.
   

  

**Scope of Services**
* Own and communicate the delivery vision, product goals, roadmap, release priorities, and measurable business outcomes for assigned Salesforce initiatives.
* Translate business needs into a well\-structured product backlog containing epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and nonfunctional requirements.
* Prioritize the backlog based on customer value, risk, regulatory needs, technical dependencies, capacity, and delivery commitments.
* Act as Scrum Master for one or more delivery teams and facilitate sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Coordinate the day\-to\-day work of Salesforce developers, QA engineers, architects, analysts, and integration partners without replacing their technical accountability.
* Establish sprint goals, confirm story readiness, remove delivery impediments, monitor progress, manage scope, and support timely decision\-making.
* Partner with QA engineers to define acceptance strategy, test coverage, defect priorities, quality gates, release readiness, and production validation.
* Manage project plans, milestones, resource needs, RAID logs, dependencies, budgets or forecasts where applicable, and executive delivery reporting.
* Identify, assess, communicate, and mitigate delivery, technical, security, compliance, vendor, schedule, resource, and operational risks.
* Lead cross\-functional stakeholder discussions, resolve competing priorities, document decisions, and maintain alignment between business and technology teams.
* Coordinate release planning, change management, cutover readiness, production support, lessons learned, and transition to ongoing operations.


**Required Experience And Qualifications**
* Five or more years of experience in technical product ownership, Agile delivery leadership, project management, Scrum leadership, or a comparable role.
* Demonstrated experience managing software developers, QA engineers, and cross\-functional technology teams through complex enterprise delivery.
* Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum practices, backlog management, estimation, capacity planning, velocity, release planning, and continuous improvement.
* Proven project\-management experience across scope, schedule, resources, dependencies, status reporting, stakeholder expectations, and delivery governance.
* Strong people\-management and team\-leadership skills, including coaching, delegation, conflict resolution, accountability, performance feedback, and team development.
* Strong risk\-management experience, including maintaining RAID logs, quantifying impact and probability, establishing owners and mitigation plans, and escalating decisions appropriately.
* Ability to create clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, product documentation, executive summaries, and decision materials.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills.


**Scrum Master and Team Leadership Expectations**
* Facilitate effective, time\-boxed Scrum ceremonies and ensure each ceremony produces clear decisions, actions, and accountable owners.
* Protect the team from unnecessary disruption while maintaining transparency and productive engagement with stakeholders.
* Use delivery metrics such as velocity, predictability, cycle time, throughput, escaped defects, blocked work, and burn trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Promote healthy collaboration between product, engineering, QA, architecture, security, operations, and business teams.
* Coach team members on story quality, estimation, definition of ready, definition of done, quality ownership, and sustainable delivery practices.
* Escalate material risks and impediments early, with options, impact analysis, and recommended decisions.


**Salesforce Experience: Preferred**
* Experience delivering Salesforce projects involving Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, digital engagement, Einstein Bots, Agentforce, or integrated enterprise applications.
* Understanding of Salesforce release planning, environments, sandboxes, metadata deployment, data migration, security, profiles, permission sets, and platform limits.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Salesforce architects, administrators, Apex and LWC developers, integration engineers, and Salesforce QA automation engineers.
* Experience coordinating Salesforce DevOps and release processes using tools such as Salesforce DX, Azure DevOps, Gearset, Git, Copado, or comparable platforms.
* Knowledge of API integrations, middleware, data synchronization, production support, and cross\-system dependency management.


**Preferred Tools And Delivery Practices**
* Azure DevOps Boards, Jira, Rally, or an equivalent Agile planning and work\-management platform.
* Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Miro, or comparable collaboration and documentation tools.
* Roadmap, dependency, resource, and portfolio\-management tools appropriate for enterprise delivery.
* Experience with hybrid Agile delivery, vendor coordination, distributed teams, and globally aligned release plans.
* Experience working in regulated environments with security, privacy, compliance, audit, and change\-management requirements.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), or equivalent product\-owner certification.
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent Scrum Master certification.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent project\-management certification.
* SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, SAFe Scrum Master, or comparable scaled\-Agile certification.
* Salesforce Certified Administrator, Salesforce Certified Business Analyst, Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder, or Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant.


**AI\-Assisted Product and Delivery Management**
* Use approved AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor to accelerate backlog analysis, epic decomposition, user\-story drafting, acceptance\-criteria creation, refinement preparation, dependency identification, and delivery documentation.
* Use AI assistance to summarize stakeholder input, meetings, risks, decisions, defects, and technical discussions into actionable backlog and project\-management artifacts.
* Use AI to identify ambiguity, missing edge cases, nonfunctional requirements, duplicate work, dependencies, and potential delivery risks while retaining human ownership of prioritization and decisions.
* Validate AI\-generated stories and acceptance criteria with business, architecture, development, and QA stakeholders to ensure clarity, feasibility, testability, security, compliance, and business value.
* Follow enterprise policies for approved tools, confidential information, prompt handling, intellectual property, auditability, and responsible AI use.


**Expected Deliverables and Outcomes**
* Prioritized and delivery\-ready product backlog aligned with roadmap, business value, architecture, quality, and release objectives.
* Well\-run Scrum ceremonies with documented goals, decisions, actions, risks, dependencies, and accountable owners.
* Realistic delivery plans, sprint and release forecasts, milestone tracking, and transparent status reporting.
* Current RAID log with effective mitigation, contingency, escalation, and decision management.
* Coordinated development and QA execution with clear acceptance criteria, quality gates, defect priorities, and release\-readiness evidence.
* Stakeholder alignment, timely decision\-making, controlled scope, and measurable continuous improvement in team delivery.
* Release, cutover, production\-validation, knowledge\-transfer, and operational\-readiness documentation.

The role will be responsible for shaping and delivering the product roadmap, tracking delivery schedules, timelines and derailers, and highlighting potential scope creep, bottlenecks and challenges to stakeholders.
   

  

 The individual is expected to independently manage and execute end\-to\-end delivery, partnering closely with Repo and Securities Lending trading, middle office, operations, collateral, risk, finance and technology stakeholders. The candidate will lead product change through the Agile delivery lifecycle, run respective scrums, and actively participate in global team discussions, projects and process enhancement plans.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Own the product roadmap and execution for the new Repo and Securities Lending trading platform, with particular focus on collateral optimization, collateral allocation, inventory management and inventory utilization.
* Translate front office and middle office needs into clear target\-state capabilities, features, user stories, acceptance criteria and delivery priorities.
* Bring strong understanding of the end\-to\-end Securities Finance trade lifecycle across Repo Trading and Securities Lending, including trade capture, inventory management, matching, confirmation, settlement, lifecycle events, margin, segregation, collateral management, optimization, accounting, reporting and close\-out.
* Drive enhancements in trading capabilities, electronic execution and risk management tools across the Repo and Securities Lending product lifecycle.
* Partner with traders, middle office, operations, collateral teams, risk, finance, legal, compliance and technology to design solutions that are commercially effective, operationally sustainable and well controlled.
* Manage product delivery schedules, dependencies, risks, scope changes, bottlenecks, testing readiness and implementation outcomes across business and technology teams.
* Define and track product outcomes and performance measures to support prioritization, launch readiness and ongoing optimization, including product adoption, delivery progress, operational efficiency, inventory utilization, control effectiveness and risk reduction.
* Work within an Agile Product Development framework, including Scrum, and use workflow and collaboration tools such as Confluence and JIRA to document and deliver business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and to maintain a well\-prioritized product backlog.
* Directly engage with senior leaders and global stakeholders to communicate progress, trade\-offs, decisions, issues and required actions.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
*Securonix is leading the transformation of cybersecurity by helping organizations stay ahead of modern threats. Security teams are no longer constrained by data or tools. They are constrained by speed, clarity, and confidence. Securonix was built to close that gap. Our mission is to enable security teams to decide and act faster across the entire threat lifecycle.*
*The Securonix Unified Defense SIEM is the industry’s first platform powered by agentic AI and designed with a human\-in\-the\-loop philosophy. It unifies detection, investigation, and response in a single system. Advanced UEBA delivers deep behavioral insight across users, entities, and data. Native threat intelligence continuously enriches detections and investigations with real\-world context. AI reinforces every layer of the platform while keeping accountability with the security team.*
*Built cloud\-native for scale and performance, the platform enables real\-time analytics, deep investigation, and automated response without compromise. Analysts gain faster access to relevant signals. Investigations move from days to minutes. Response becomes consistent and measurable. The result is a CyberOps experience that scales as threats evolve.*
*Securonix is recognized as a six\-time Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and a Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights. The company has been featured by leading publications including WIRED, Dark Reading, and Fortune for its innovation and leadership in security operations. Organizations rely on the platform for always\-available data, rapid search and investigation, continuously updated threat content, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response experience.*
*Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s leading enterprise software investors, Securonix benefits from deep operational expertise and a long\-term commitment to innovation and growth. This partnership strengthens our ability to scale the platform, accelerate product execution, and support customers as their security needs evolve.*
*With more than 1,000 customers worldwide, including a meaningful portion of the Fortune 100, Securonix operates at global scale. Our ecosystem of partners and managed security service providers extends that reach, helping organizations deploy and operate with confidence wherever they do business. What drives us is how we work.*
* We win as one team. We operate with trust, respect, and shared accountability.
* We are customer\-driven. Innovation is guided by real security challenges and measurable outcomes.
* We act with agility. Change is constant, and we stay aligned on purpose while adapting fast.


*That focus is how Securonix helps organizations move from reactive security to proactive, autonomous operations.*
 Securonix provides the Next Generation Security and Information Event Management (SIEM) solution. As a recognized leader in the SIEM industry, Securonix helps some of the largest organizations globally detect sophisticated cyberattacks and respond to them within minutes. The Securonix SNYPR platform is built on big data Hadoop technologies and is infinitely scalable. Our platform is used by some of the largest organizations in the financial, healthcare, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, and federal sectors.
   

  

**Summary**
 As a Product Manager at Securonix you will drive product strategy, roadmap execution, and cross\-functional alignment for key areas of the Securonix platform. You will work closely with customers, Engineering, Data Science, UX, Sales, and security practitioners to deliver innovative capabilities that solve real\-world cybersecurity challenges.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with a deep curiosity for cybersecurity, analytics, AI/ML\-driven detection, and cloud technologies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own and define a product domain vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with customer needs and company objectives.

* Collaborate with engineering and design teams to deliver high\-quality features and platform capabilities.
* Translate complex cybersecurity workflows into intuitive product experiences
* Drive the full product lifecycle from concept through launch and ongoing optimization.
* Conduct market, competitive, and customer research to identify opportunities and trends.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering to support go\-to\-market activities.
* Develop product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release documentation.
* Analyze product usage, adoption metrics, and customer feedback to guide prioritization decisions.
* Work with data science and threat research teams to improve detection content, analytics, and automation capabilities.
* Represent the product in customer briefings, webinars, conferences, and analyst interactions.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in enterprise\-grade SaaS platforms, with at least 4 years in a leading product management role.
* Experience with NextGen SIEM, UEBA, MSSP, EDR, NDR, XDR products, or similar cybersecurity analytics platforms is essential.
* Experience working with SaaS and cloud\-native platforms.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.
* Ability to influence and collaborate across technical and business teams.
* Agile and lead product management experience with a strong entrepreneurial and start\-up mindset.
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, detail\-oriented, and able to juggle multiple projects and tasks.
* The ability to work effectively and independently in a fast\-paced environment, collaborating with geographically distributed teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in cybersecurity operations, threat detection, SOC workflows, Incident Management platforms, AI\-driven threat hunting, reporting, dashboarding, or API technologies.
* Familiarity with AI/ML applications in cybersecurity.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with APIs, data pipelines, telemetry, or analytics platforms.
* Be an expert in competitive analysis and share strategic inputs to drive product definition and prioritization decisions.

title: Associate Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
 Role: Associate Consultant
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We’re MiQ, a global programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, so you will be too. No matter the role or the location, we’re all united in the vision to lead the programmatic industry and make it better.
   

  

 As a part of the DnA local products team, you will independently work with local product managers in the market to\-
   

  

* Build their product plan.
* Support in backlog grooming and sprint planning.
* Own the complete development of a product: scoping, prototyping, development, testing and release management.
* Manage the development squad: Form the squads and guide them.
* Work in partnership with all the other CoE teams such as RIS, SI, Hub, Lab etc as per the needs of the product.
* Collect feedback on product usage, gather new requirements and manage the post release lifecycle of the product.
* Support in enabling the sales, AM, Trading teams with operationalising the product for new client opportunities and existing client projects.
* Maintain product Wiki


**Who are your stakeholders?**
 As an Associate Consultant, you are required to work with different stakeholders across the MiQ ecosystem:
   

  

**Programmatic Traders:** 
 As an Associate Consultant, you collaborate with traders to test out the activation solutions to help them optimize campaigns. By leveraging your solution\-developing skills \& understanding of the programmatic landscape, you provide actionable activation segments on audience targeting, ad performance, and bidding strategies. This helps traders make data\-driven decisions, optimize their advertising campaigns, and improve overall campaign effectiveness and ROI.
   

  

**Product Managers:** 
 You work closely with the Product managers to leverage the power of data partnerships and through your EDA skills you help uncover valuable insights about customer behavior, market trends, and campaign performance. This information allows Product managers to create a product requirement \& scoping document with all the necessary details about the product's USP, capabilities thus outlining the course of product development
 **Sales Representatives:** 
 You will also be helping the sales team by creating a pitch document/presentation of the Local Product \& Solution for the clients. Your deck/doc helps identify potential opportunities and develop a gripping sales narrative. Additionally, you assist in responding to Request for Proposals (RFPs) by providing data\-driven pre\-campaign insights / white\-labeled case studies out of the products created under various verticals that help us in increasing the revenue streams.
   

  

**Agencies \& Clients:** 
 Your expertise in data analytics, statistics, data sciences \& solution development skills are invaluable for agency and advertiser clients. By providing them with planning, activation \& performance measurement solutions, you empower them to make informed decisions regarding their marketing strategies. Your final recommendations out of the solutions will help clients optimize their advertising budgets, target the right audience, and maximize the effectiveness of their campaigns. You are required to promote MiQ's internal solutions and capabilities, showcasing MiQ's unique value proposition in the programmatic landscape.
   

  

**DnA Analysts \& Data Scientists:** 
 You are required to work with the DnA Analysts \& Data Scientists to form a team with all the expertise in place for robust product development. The product developed under local products will be a collaborative effort of all the 3 experts. You will also have to train all other DnA Analyst on how to use a product, help them pitch to the client, and how to measure the impact of the solution.
   

  

 In summary, as an Associate Consultant, you add value by providing data\-driven planning, activation \& reporting solutions to traders, product managers, sales teams, and agency/advertiser clients that empower MiQ and its stakeholders to reach the right audience with the right content at the right time.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring**
**Must Haves**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent quantitative field (such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics)
* 3\.5\+ years’ experience in the analytics domain
* Proficient with either R or Python and PySpark
* Expertise in Excel and PowerPoint
* Knowledge of big data processing tools/frameworks like Qubole /Databricks/Spark, AWS
* Descriptive and Inquisitive Analytics, Statistical modelling and Advanced analytics
* Should have developed and implemented at least 3 analytics solutions end to end.
* Able to translate problems into business\-ready deliverables.
* Excellent Storytelling and visualization skills
* Exposure on Machine learning and Deep Learning
* Sound knowledge of Tableau/ PowerBI /Google Data Studio \> Design and analysis of experiments


**Good to Have**
* Exposure on API Integrations
* Programmatic Media / Ad\-Tech domain knowledge
* Knowledge of Agile methodology, Scrum framework, Sprint planning
* Exposure to project management tools such as JIRA, Trello, Monday.com etc.
* Experience applying AI/ML and Generative AI to build practical analytics solutions, including predictive models, LLM\-based tools, AI agents, automated insights and workflow automation.
* Understanding of AI\-powered product development, including translating business problems into scalable AI/data products, validating model outputs, and collaborating with Product, Engineering and Data Science teams to take solutions from proof of concept to production.


 We’ve highlighted some key skills, experience, and requirements for this role. But please don’t worry if you don’t meet every single one. Our talent team strives to find the best people. They might see something in your background that’s a fit for this role, or another opportunity at MiQ.
   

  

 If you have a passion for the role, please still apply.
   

  

**What impact will you create?**
 As an Associate Consultant, your role will create value for MiQ in the following ways:
   

  

* Driving client stickiness: With your ability to leverage different datasets in the MiQ ecosystem and develop solutions out of it, you will help the team in gathering requirements for vertical\-specific products, collecting \& incorporating feedback from the market and the clients, managing the post\-release lifecycle of the product and further identifying enhancement opportunities leading to improved client stickiness
* Driving Profitability: By leveraging the power of data you are expected to identify areas where we can create automated targeting solutions or optimization strategies that optimize costs \& enhance performance of campaigns thus improving profitability and providing competitive edge
* MiQ Growth: Being on top of the key product trends that are leading the industry \& the ability to leverage data within MiQ ecosystem to create competitive or improved solutions to help support MiQ's current business \& tap into new revenue streams to drive growth
* Support Key Decision Making: Your expertise in data analysis and solution development approach provides decision\-makers with the necessary information to make informed choices. Your products help guide agency, advertisers \& internal stakeholders in making strategic and tactical decisions that align with MiQ or client's objectives.
* Analytics Best Practices: As an Associate Consultant, you are expected to introduce analytics, statistics \& solutions best practices within the team, helping in setting up products and quality frameworks within the team \& internal stakeholders
* Developing Custom Analytics Solutions: Leveraging your experience in product development in conjunction with statistics \& advanced analytics, you will be expected to provide solutions to the vertical level problems \& lead the development of MiQ local products technically \& assist in enhancing their adoption within the target market


**What’s in it for you?**
 Our Center of Excellence is the very heart of MiQ, and it’s where the magic happens. It means everything you do and everything you create will have a huge impact across our entire global business.
   

  

 MiQ is incredibly proud to foster a welcoming culture. We do everything possible to make sure everyone feels valued for what they bring. With global teams committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we’re always moving towards becoming an even better place to work.
   

  

**Values**
 Our values are so much more than statements

 They unite MiQers in every corner of the world. They shape the way we work and the decisions we make. And they inspire us to stay true to ourselves and to aim for better. Our values are there to be embraced by everyone, so that we naturally live and breathe them. Just like inclusivity, our values flow through everything we do \- no matter how big or small.
   

  

* We do what we love \- Passion

* We always unite \- Unite
* We dare to be unconventional \- Courage


**Benefits**
 Every region and office have specific perks and benefits, but every person joining MiQ can expect:
   

  

* A hybrid work environment
* New hire orientation with job specific onboarding and training
* Internal and global mobility opportunities
* Competitive healthcare benefits
* Bonus and performance incentives

title: Manager - DAU Growth
description:
**About The Team**
 Meesho is the most downloaded e\-commerce app in India. As part of the core Business and Product\-Experience team, we are taking a massive leap from a purely transactional e\-commerce platform to a destination for visual discovery and personal inspiration.
   

  

 We are building an inspiration
 **feed** 
 inside the Meesho app, focused on look\-based, trend\-based, and highly personalized inspiration across major lifestyle categories like
 **Fashion, Home, and Beauty** 
 . Our team holds the end\-to\-end responsibility to figure out the supply of engaging content, establish content partnerships, and solve complex discovery and ranking problems to scale daily active users (DAU). We focus on personal growth, high\-impact innovation, and thinking 10x.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Manager for the Content Commerce team, you will be the driving force behind how millions of users organically discover trends and find personal inspiration on Meesho. This is a 0\-to\-1 charter where you will solve the dual challenge of
 **Content Supply** 
 and
 **Algorithmic Ranking/Discovery** 
 .
   

  

 You will own user engagement, DAU growth, and content\-to\-commerce conversion metrics by ensuring our feed surfaces highly relevant, visually stunning, and localized content.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* 0\-to\-1 Strategy \& Vision: Own the long\-term (3Y) and mid\-term (6M) strategic planning for the content feed charter, operating with a "Think 10x" mindset.


* Content Supply \& Partnerships: Figure out and scale the supply of high\-quality, trend\-based visual content. Establish partnerships with creators, influencers, or content syndicates to seed the platform.
* Discovery \& Ranking Optimization: Collaborate heavily with Data Science and Product teams to build and refine ranking systems that surface the right looks and trends based on individual user preferences.
* Cohort\-Based Engagement: Deeply understand different user cohorts across India to curate and personalize feeds, driving higher daily active usage (DAU) and long\-term retention.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Act as the bridge between Content Creators, Category Marketing, Product, Data Science, and Seller Experience teams to seamlessly turn inspiration into purchasing behavior.


**What You Will Need**
 Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 3\-5 years of experience in product\-led growth, content ecosystem management, or digital discovery platforms.
   

  

 Target Background: Prior experience working or leading trend\-based, visual\-first platforms or similar content\-to\-commerce startups is highly preferred.
   

  

 Problem\-Solving \& Grit: Strong analytical aptitude and a proven track record of solving complex, ambiguous discovery and ranking problems.
   

  

 Execution Bias: A true hustler with a strong bias for speed and execution, capable of multitasking and tactical delivery in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Mindset: Passion for "Problem First Solving" (PFS) and the ability to build 0\-to\-1 scalable business models.

title: Founder's Office
description:
Most Strategy and Operations roles quietly turn into reporting jobs. You pull the numbers, format the decks, and remind people about deadlines.
 **This is not that role.** 




  





 This is the role for someone who wants to learn, at close range, how a fast growing company actually plans, prioritizes, and executes. You will work directly with the CEO and the leadership team on the problems that cut across functions, the ones no single team can solve alone. Your job is to turn ambiguity into a plan, and a plan into results.
 



  





 For the right person, this also happens to be one of the best leadership educations available anywhere. People who do this job well at Hevo build the instincts of a real operator, and many go on to run things. But the simplest reason to take it is this: you get to work on what matters most, alongside the people who decide it.
 



  





**What you will own:** 




  





**1\. The operational rhythm of the whole company.** 
 You will work with the CEO to keep the entire machine moving across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Engineering, HR, Solutions, and Support. You will run the OKR process with the leadership team, drive quarterly planning and goal setting, and track delivery so nothing important slips. You will be the person who can tell, on any given day, how healthy the organization really is and where attention is needed next.
 



  





**2\. The strategic projects that move the needle.** 
 You will partner with the CEO and other leaders to spot the initiatives that genuinely change the trajectory of the business, then own them end to end until they are big enough to stand on their own and get handed to a dedicated team. These are the bets that matter most, and you will be trusted to carry them.
 



  





**3\. Cross functional execution and alignment.** 
 You will be the connective tissue across functions, driving communication so the company moves as one. You will be a real thought partner to leadership on vision, priorities, and the hard tradeoffs. You will manage relationships with stakeholders inside and outside the company, and when needed, represent leadership in reviews.
 



  





**Why this role is special:** 




  





 Three things make this seat genuinely rare.
 



  





**You get the full view.** 
 Most people spend a decade seeing one function. You will see all of them at once, from the vantage point of the executive team, inside a company growing fast enough to teach you something new every week.
 



  





**You work on first of a kind problems.** 
 Nearly every problem you solve will be one you have not solved before. There is no playbook handed to you. You build the playbook. For the right person, that is the most fun part of the job.
 



  





**You build an operator's judgment.** 
 Custodian of rhythm, owner of strategic projects, thought partner to leadership. That is the exact muscle set strong operators and founders are made of. You will leave this role with judgment most people take many more years to develop.
 



  





**What you will need to bring:** 




  





 We hire for abilities first, because knowledge and skills can be taught and abilities are far harder to build. Here is what we are really looking for.
 



  





**1\. Stakeholder management.** 
 You build trust with people at every level and quickly read what actually drives them. People want to work with you, and they tell you the truth.
 



  





**2\. People leadership.** 
 You understand what good leadership looks like up close. You know how to find the right levers and use them to bring out strong performance, and you have nudged teams into action in a way that energized them.
 



  





**3\. First principles problem solving.** 
 You are sharp with data, analytics, and reasoning. You break unfamiliar problems down to their fundamentals and build your way back up to a clear answer.
 



  





**4\. Ownership.** 
 You take a problem and you get it solved, full stop. You enjoy the wins, you own the misses, and you fix them. High accountability, no excuses.
 



  





**5\. Outwork and outsmart.** 
 You bring operational rigour and intensity. You find the smarter path, and you also do the work.
 



  





**6\. Independent thinking.** 
 You form your own point of view from the inputs in front of you, build conviction, and have the courage to make the call.
 



  





**7\. High agency.** 
 You move things forward mostly through influence, rarely through authority. You align people around the company wide goal by convincing them, not commanding them.
 



  





**Who tends to thrive here:** 




 The people who do exceptionally well in this seat usually share a pattern. They are intensely curious about how businesses work. They are comfortable being thrown into something they have never done and figuring it out. They care more about the outcome than the credit. And they have the energy to keep going when a problem turns out to be harder than it first looked, because that is usually where the most interesting work begins.

title: Director, Product
description:
**Company Introduction**
 Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting\-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.
   

  

 Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**About Availity**
 Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real\-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.
   

  

**About Availity India**
 Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India teams partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.
   

  

 Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Availity is seeking a Director, Product Management – Core Solutions to lead a portfolio of foundational products and capabilities that have powered the healthcare ecosystem for more than 25 years. This leader will be responsible for driving the strategy, execution, modernization, and operational excellence of Availity's established solutions, including Availity Essentials, Essentials Pro, administrative and clinical connectivity products, and other core platform capabilities relied upon by health plans, providers, and partners every day.
   

  

 This role is uniquely positioned at the intersection of stability and innovation. Success requires balancing reliability, predictability, and disciplined delivery with continuous modernization and thoughtful innovation that advances Availity's vision for the next generation of healthcare connectivity.
   

  

 The Director will lead product managers responsible for critical, high\-scale solutions and will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Operations, Commercial teams, Customer Experience, and executive leadership to deliver efficient, unified, world\-class experiences that customers trust to run their businesses.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy \& Portfolio Leadership**
* Define and execute the product strategy for Availity's Core Solutions portfolio.
* Establish a clear modernization roadmap that enhances customer value while maintaining operational excellence and platform stability.
* Balance customer needs, business priorities, regulatory requirements, and technical investments across a mature portfolio.
* Identify opportunities to simplify experiences, consolidate capabilities, and create a more unified customer journey across products.
* Drive strategic decisions that strengthen Availity's position as the industry's trusted healthcare connectivity platform.


**Execution Excellence**
* Lead planning, prioritization, and delivery processes across multiple product teams.
* Create a culture of disciplined execution with predictable outcomes, measurable results, and operational rigor.
* Establish clear objectives, success measures, and performance metrics for products and teams.
* Ensure delivery commitments are achieved while maintaining high quality, reliability, scalability, and security standards.
* Use data, customer insights, and market intelligence to guide product investments and tradeoff decisions.


**Customer Experience \& Innovation**
* Champion seamless, efficient, and world\-class user experiences across the Core Solutions portfolio.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce friction, improve usability, and increase customer satisfaction.
* Partner closely with customers and stakeholders to understand evolving market needs and emerging opportunities.
* Introduce innovation thoughtfully and responsibly within established products without compromising trust, stability, or operational performance.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, APIs, platform services, and emerging technologies to improve customer outcomes.


**Leadership \& Talent Development**
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of product managers and product leaders.
* Foster a high\-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, customer centricity, and outcomes.
* Build strong partnerships across Engineering, UX, Operations, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and executive leadership teams.
* Elevate product management maturity through best practices in discovery, prioritization, roadmap management, and outcome measurement.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to senior leadership.


**Business \& Operational Ownership**
* Manage portfolio performance through business metrics, customer outcomes, adoption, retention, and operational KPIs.
* Develop business cases and investment recommendations for modernization and growth initiatives.
* Ensure products remain compliant with evolving healthcare regulations and industry standards.
* Drive operational improvements that increase efficiency, scalability, and customer value.


**Required Qualifications**
* 15\+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years in US healthcare leading product teams and managers.
* Proven experience managing mature, enterprise\-scale products with large customer bases and high operational complexity.
* Demonstrated success balancing product innovation with stability, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Strong background in platform, enterprise software, healthcare technology, or connectivity solutions.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams through large\-scale modernization and transformation initiatives.
* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and decision\-making skills.
* Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Track record of delivering measurable business and customer outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in healthcare technology, payer\-provider connectivity, revenue cycle, clinical interoperability, or related healthcare domains.
* Familiarity with healthcare transactions, administrative workflows, clinical data exchange, APIs, and interoperability standards.
* Experience managing platform products, ecosystem products, or network\-based businesses.
* MBA or advanced degree preferred.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Within this role, you will:
   

  

* Deliver highly reliable and predictable product outcomes across a mission\-critical portfolio.
* Modernize core solutions while preserving customer trust and operational stability.
* Improve customer satisfaction through more consistent and unified user experiences.
* Increase delivery effectiveness and execution discipline across product teams.
* Strengthen product\-market fit of established solutions through continuous innovation and customer engagement.
* Help evolve Availity's platform toward the future of healthcare connectivity while protecting and growing the business that customers depend on today.


**Leadership Competencies**
**The Ideal Candidate Demonstrates**
* Customer Obsession – Deep understanding of customer workflows and business outcomes.
* Operational Excellence – Drives reliability, consistency, and predictable execution.
* Strategic Vision – Balances today's commitments with tomorrow's opportunities.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6\.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.
 



  





 At Greenlight, we're here to make the day\-to\-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.
 



  





 Common Platforms builds the foundations every other product team depends on. Access, identity management, authentication and notifications are the foundation every Greenlight experience runs on, they decide who gets into the door, and whether the right person hears from us at the right moment. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, Common Platforms to own this layer end\-to\-end: the Identity and access management, the permissions that govern what parents and kids can each do, and the multi\-channel notification platform that reaches millions of families every day.
 



  





 This is a high\-leverage, high\-trust role at the center of Greenlight's platform organization. Your customers are both the families using our products who should never have to think about any of this and the product teams building on top of you, who ship faster when your systems are reliable. You'll work cross\-functionally across teams at Greenlight (US \& India) , and you'll have direct line\-of\-sight to executive leadership on the decisions that shape customer trust and platform reliability. The right person thinks in systems, and is comfortable building core platform products.
 



  





 This role reports to the Director of Product and sits within the Common Platforms team.
 



  





**Your day\-to\-day:** 



* Working closely with Engineering and design to ensure building great product.
* Work closely with key stakeholders for new requirements and ensure to keep teams updated on ongoing items
* Owning the key metrics for your product and ensuring the reliability of the product.
* Embedded in a dedicated cross\-functional pod with Engineering and Design, with close partnerships across Security, Risk and Compliance, Legal, Data, Customer Support, and the consumer product teams who depend on your platform.



  





**What you’ll bring to the team:** 



* 6\+ years in product management, with at least 2 years building platform products
* Comfortable to build long term strategy for your product vertical and drive the key projects independently end to end.
* Strong cross\-functional instincts \- you’ve navigated complex stakeholder environments including Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Payments, and know how to move fast within constraints.
* Executive presence: you communicate up and across clearly, adapt your message to your audience, and don’t wait to be asked for updates.
* Ownership mentality \- you proactively identify gaps, propose solutions, and follow through. You don’t need a playbook to get started.
* Urgency and scrappiness: experience in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments where speed matters and you figure things out yourself.



  





**Good to have:** 



* Fintech experience or a familiarity with identity and access management (IAM), authentication standards



  





**Who we are:** 




 It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" People who bring their real selves to the table and push the people around them to do the same. We win by never hesitating to jump in, offer a hand, or share the credit, because we know we're stronger together than apart. And through all of it, the mission stays the thing we measure ourselves against: are we doing right by the families counting on us? If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love for you to apply.
 



  





 Greenlight is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on age, race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including pregnancy, childbirth, or a medical condition related to pregnancy or childbirth), genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.
